items.title: 德國大幅上調2026及2027年經濟成長預估
items.title_en: Germany Significantly Raises 2026 and 2027 Economic Growth Forecasts
paras: 德國政府周四(8日)發布最新秋季經濟預測報告，大幅上調今明兩年的經濟成長預期。受惠於強勁出口、製造業展現韌性以及政府擴大支出，德國將2026年GDP成長率預估值由原先的0.5%調升逾一倍至1.3%，2027年預測值由0.9%上調至1.1%。
德國經濟部指出，儘管受中東衝突影響價格攀升以及美國關稅帶來不確定性，德國第二季經濟仍成長0.3%。
本次經濟回升主要由政府以舉債融資推動的基礎建設投資、強化國防武力，以及企業增加德國製造能源密集型產品庫存所帶動。官方預估2026年出口將成長3.7%，但2028年受地緣政治動盪影響，經濟成長率恐放緩至0.6%。
針對經濟前景，德國經濟部長Katherina Reiche表示：「德國經濟正在成長，這是一個重要訊號，但這只是個開始。」
她強調，現在關鍵在於將初期的復甦轉化為真正的經濟動能，並指出：「這種成長必須具備自我維持的能力，這正是我們必須持續推進改革的原因。」
此外，通膨壓力仍不容忽視，官方預計2026年與2027年通膨率將分別達2.7%與3.0%。
為減輕民眾負擔，總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的政府決定自10月起至12月底，將汽油與柴油每公升減稅0.17歐元。經濟部提醒，未來經濟走勢將高度取決於中東及烏克蘭地緣政治衝突的後續演變。
paras_en: Germany's government on Thursday (the 8th) released its latest autumn economic forecast, sharply raising growth expectations for this year and next. Benefiting from strong exports, resilient manufacturing and expanded government spending, Germany lifted its 2026 GDP growth estimate from the original 0.5% to 1.3%—more than double—and raised the 2027 forecast from 0.9% to 1.1%.
The German Ministry of Economy noted that despite price rises caused by the Middle East conflict and uncertainty from U.S. tariffs, Germany's economy still grew 0.3% in the second quarter.

The rebound is mainly driven by government‑financed infrastructure investment, strengthened defence capabilities, and firms increasing inventories of energy‑intensive manufactured products. Officials project 2026 exports to grow 3.7%, but in 2028, geopolitical turbulence could slow the growth rate to 0.6%.
On the economic outlook, Economy Minister Katherina Reiche said: “The German economy is growing, which is an important signal, but it is only the beginning.”
She emphasized that the key now is to turn the early recovery into genuine economic momentum, adding: “This growth must be self‑sustaining, which is why we must continue to push reforms.”
In addition, inflation pressures remain a concern; officials expect inflation rates of 2.7% in 2026 and 3.0% in 2027.

To ease the burden on households, the government led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz decided to cut the tax on gasoline and diesel by €0.17 per litre from October through the end of December. The ministry warned that future economic trends will heavily depend on how the Middle East and Ukraine geopolitical conflicts evolve.

items.title: 水資源挑戰升溫 貿協10/15邀專家探解方、聚焦AI水處理到產業實務
items.title_en: Water Resource Challenges Heat Up: Trade Association Invites Experts on Oct 15 to Explore Solutions, Focuses on AI Water Treatment and Industry Practices
paras: 面對極端氣候、新興污染物及水資源等挑戰，全球水資源議題升溫，為協助產業掌握趨勢與創新解方，貿協將於下周10月15日於南港展覽館舉辦「2026年全球水資源永續論壇」，匯聚國內外水資源專家及產業代表，聚焦PFAS政策、AI水處理、水資源再生、工業水循環及洪水風險管理等議題，從政策、科技到產業實務，探討高用水產業面對水資源挑戰的因應之道。
貿協表示，本次論壇邀請三位國際水資源及氣候韌性領域專家，分享全球水資源永續發展趨勢，三位講者分別從水資源再生、洪水防護及AI技術切入，呈現全球水資源永續與氣候韌性的最新發展。
貿協指出，PFAS等新興污染物已成為全球水質管理的重要議題，論壇邀請環境部化學物質管理署及美國水質協會(WQA)，分別從台灣政策及美國法規發展的角度，解析PFAS風險管理與國際法規趨勢，協助業者掌握水質管理挑戰及國際市場對污染物管理與水質安全的要求。
在科技創新與產業應用方面，經濟部水利署將分享水利工程減碳推動成果，臥龍智慧環境說明AI水處理技術的跨產業應用，中宇環保工程則介紹工業水循環實務案例，探討科技如何提升用水效率、降低環境衝擊，加速企業邁向水資源永續轉型。
貿協表示，水資源管理已不只是環境議題，更與企業營運韌性、成本管理及國際市場競爭力密切相關，本次論壇串聯政府、國際組織、技術供應商及高用水產業，促進跨域交流與國際合作，協助台灣產業掌握全球發展趨勢，尋找符合自身需求的解方。
paras_en: Facing extreme climate, emerging pollutants and water resource challenges, global water issues are heating up. To help industry grasp trends and innovative solutions, the Trade Association will hold the “2026 Global Water Resource Sustainability Forum” on October 15 at the Nangang Exhibition Hall, gathering domestic and international water experts and industry representatives to focus on PFAS policy, AI water treatment, water resource regeneration, industrial water recycling and flood risk management, discussing responses from policy, technology to practical industry for high‑water‑use sectors confronting water challenges.

The Trade Association said the forum will invite three international experts in water resources and climate resilience to share global sustainable water development trends. The speakers will address water regeneration, flood protection and AI technology, presenting the latest developments in sustainable water and climate resilience worldwide.

The Trade Association noted that emerging pollutants such as PFAS have become a key issue in global water quality management. The forum invites Taiwan’s Environmental Protection Administration Chemical Substances Management Office and the U.S. Water Quality Association (WQA) to analyze PFAS risk management and international regulatory trends from the perspectives of Taiwanese policy and U.S. regulations, helping businesses understand water quality challenges and international market requirements for pollutant control and water safety.

Regarding technological innovation and industrial application, the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Water Resources Agency will share achievements in carbon‑reduction water engineering, Wolong Smart Environment will explain cross‑industry AI water‑treatment technology, and Zhongyu Environmental Engineering will present practical cases of industrial water recycling, exploring how technology can boost water‑use efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and accelerate corporate transition to sustainable water management.

The Trade Association stated that water resource management is no longer just an environmental issue; it is closely tied to corporate operational resilience, cost management and international competitiveness. The forum links government, international organizations, technology providers and high‑water‑use industries to promote cross‑sector dialogue and international cooperation, helping Taiwanese firms keep pace with global trends and find solutions that meet their specific needs.

items.title: 韋僑9月營收創歷史次高、Q3營收連創新高 全年營收再突破
items.title_en: Wei Chiao September Revenue Hits Historical Second‑Highest, Q3 Revenue Sets New High, Full‑Year Revenue Breaks Through
paras: RFID 解決方案供應商韋僑 (6417-TW) 遷入新廠的綜效正在高度發揮，且醫療應用需求回升挹注，單季營收已在 2025 年第四季起連續3季創新高，韋僑今(8)日公布9月營收1.72億元改寫歷史次高，月增0.67%，年增18.26%，第三季營收5.1億元再創新高，年增25.85%。
韋僑2026年前三季營收14.44億元，年增22.08%，再創同期新高，全年營收將改寫新高。韋僑2026年1-9月營收14.44億元，年增幅達22.08%。第四季營運也有再向上突破的契機，法人估韋僑2026年下半年的單月平均營收將在1.7億元之上。

韋僑在2026年第二季營收以 5.06 億元續改寫歷史新高， 2026 年第二季營收 5.06 億元，創新高，毛利率 34.71%，季增 0.14 個百分點，年增 3.43 個百分點，單季稅後純益以 8204 萬元創新高，季增 15.89%，年增 2.01 倍，每股純益 1.94 元優於預期。韋僑 2026 年上半年營收 9.34 億元，毛利率 34.65%，年增 2.85 個百分點，稅後純益 1.53 億元，年增 89.13%，每股純益 3.62 元。
在韋僑推出於 Ambient IoT 的 BLE TAG 新產品，預計在下半年出貨將呈現倍數成長同時，下半年估單月業績也平均達 1.7 億元。同時以韋僑的訂單及出貨而言，2026 年第三季可望續創新高。全年營收將突破 2025 年營收歷史新高的 16.07 億元水準。
同時，韋僑在積極開創海外新布局同時，法人估 2026 年全年上看每股純益 7-7.5 元，同時，韋僑在 2027 年力拼賺回一個股本。
韋僑的無線射頻 RFID 解決方案醫療應用需求正在明顯回升，同時，在韋僑科技預計將進一步在大股東希華 (2484-TW) 的全力協助開拓日本市場，在日本設立生產線以在地法人型態搶攻境內醫、藥品界對 RFID 解決方案需求。韋僑科技對於赴日本龐大醫藥市場的 RFID 解決方案生產，預計在 2028 年進入量產。
paras_en: RFID solutions provider Wei Chiao (6417‑TW) is reaping the synergies of moving into its new plant, and a rebound in medical‑application demand is boosting sales. Quarterly revenue has set new records for three consecutive quarters starting in Q4 2025. On the 8th, Wei Chiao reported September revenue of NT$172 million, a historic second‑highest figure, up 0.67% month‑over‑month and 18.26% year‑over‑year. Q3 revenue reached NT$510 million, a new high, up 25.85% year‑over‑year.

Wei Chiao posted revenue of NT$1.444 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, a 22.08% year‑over‑year increase and a new peak for the period, indicating that full‑year revenue will set a new record. The company’s fourth‑quarter operations also have upside, with analysts estimating that average monthly revenue in the second half of 2026 will exceed NT$170 million.

In Q2 2026, Wei Chiao’s revenue rose to NT$506 million, again a historic high, with a gross margin of 34.71%, up 0.14 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.43 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax hit NT$82.04 million, a new high, up 15.89% quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.01‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$1.94, beating expectations. For the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$934 million, gross margin 34.65% (up 2.85 points YoY), net profit NT$153 million (up 89.13% YoY), and EPS NT$3.62.

Wei Chiao’s newly launched BLE TAG product for Ambient IoT is expected to see multiple‑fold shipment growth in the second half of the year, with average monthly sales projected at NT$170 million. Based on its order and shipment pipeline, Q3 2026 is also expected to set a new high, and full‑year revenue is projected to surpass the 2025 record level of NT$1.607 billion.
Analysts estimate that Wei Chiao’s full‑year 2026 earnings per share could reach NT$7.0‑7.5, while the company is actively expanding overseas and aims to recoup one share‑capital unit in 2027.

Demand for Wei Chiao’s wireless RFID solutions in medical applications is clearly rebounding. With strong support from major shareholder Xi‑Hua (2484‑TW), the company plans to establish a production line in Japan to serve the domestic medical and pharmaceutical markets there. Production for the Japanese RFID solution market is slated to enter mass production in 2028.

items.title: ChatGPT還沒問世就出手！老虎環球押對OpenAI 帳面獲利上看50億美元
items.title_en: Tiger Global Bet on OpenAI Before ChatGPT Launched, Eyeing $5 B Paper Profit
paras: 在ChatGPT問世前一年，老虎環球(Tiger Global)便押注OpenAI，如今這筆早期投資有望帶來50億美元帳面獲利，成為該公司成立25年來最成功的投資之一，也為這家曾遭科技股重挫打擊的投資機構扳回一城。
據《彭博》周四(8日)報導，OpenAI正洽談以1.4兆美元估值募資300億美元。知情人士透露，若以此估值計算，老虎環球持股的潛在獲利可達50億美元，但仍屬尚未實現的帳面收益。

ChatGPT問世前搶先布局 早期押注推升基金表現

2021年，OpenAI共同創辦人暨執行長阿特曼致電老虎環球創辦人柯爾曼(Chase Coleman)，邀請他以157億美元估值，成為少數投資OpenAI的機構投資人之一。當時距離ChatGPT公開推出還有一年，多數大型投資人尚未察覺其潛力。
老虎環球當年同意投入1.5億美元，之後多次加碼，並成為首家投資OpenAI的避險基金。隨著ChatGPT於2022年爆紅並掀起AI軍備競賽，這筆提前布局的投資開始展現成果。
知情人士指出，OpenAI投資已帶動老虎環球旗下避險基金，以及同時投資上市與未上市公司的基金，今年前九個月分別上漲9.4%與19.3%。
OpenAI也是老虎環球最新一期創投基金的最大持股之一。截至6月30日，該基金未扣費用的內部報酬率(IRR)達65%，扣除費用後為44%。這些數字反映整體基金表現，並非單筆OpenAI投資報酬率。
不過，老虎環球仍須等到OpenAI首次公開發行(IPO)，才能完全出脫持股、實現收益，而阿特曼已將上市時程延至至少明年。老虎環球與OpenAI均不予置評。

科技股重挫後調整策略 聚焦規模較小的集中投資

這筆投資對老虎環球具有重振旗鼓的意義。2022年，利率攀升重創新創企業，科技股大跌與創投資產估值下修，使其管理資產由1,000億美元驟降至500億美元。
旗下多檔基金虧損引發高層改組，也促使公司回歸規模較小、持股更集中的投資策略，由柯爾曼加強掌管流動性較低的投資。目前公司管理資產約600億美元。
柯爾曼也更直接參與最新創投基金Private Investment Partners 16的管理。該基金規模27億美元，為約十年來最小，除OpenAI外，也投資Anthropic、自駕車公司Waymo與AI新創Temporal Technologies。
OpenAI如今可望躋身老虎環球歷來最成功的投資之列。該公司2010年投資京東(JD-US)(09618-HK)，曾獲利逾65億美元；2009年押注Flipkart，則帶來35億美元收益。相較之下，OpenAI的50億美元潛在獲利雖相當可觀，最終成果仍待實際退出時驗證。
paras_en: A year before ChatGPT debuted, Tiger Global placed a bet on OpenAI, and the early stake now looks set to generate a $5 billion paper gain – one of the firm’s most successful investments in its 25‑year history and a comeback for the firm that was hit hard by a tech‑stock rout.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday (the 8th), OpenAI is in talks to raise $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Sources said that at that valuation Tiger Global’s holding could be worth about $5 billion in potential profit, though the gain remains unrealised on paper.

Tiger Global’s early positioning before ChatGPT’s launch boosted fund performance. In 2021, OpenAI co‑founder and CEO Sam Altman called Tiger Global founder Chase Coleman and invited him to invest at a $15.7 billion valuation, making Tiger one of the few institutional investors in OpenAI. At the time, ChatGPT was still a year away from public release and most large investors had not yet recognised its potential.

Tiger Global agreed to put in $150 million that year and later added to the stake, becoming the first hedge fund to back OpenAI. As ChatGPT went viral in 2022 and sparked an AI arms race, the pre‑emptive investment began to pay off.

Sources said OpenAI’s investment has lifted Tiger Global’s hedge‑fund arm as well as its funds that invest in both listed and private companies, which rose 9.4% and 19.3% respectively in the first nine months of this year.

OpenAI is also one of the largest holdings in Tiger Global’s latest venture fund. As of June 30, the fund’s internal rate of return (IRR) was 65% before fees and 44% after fees – figures that reflect overall fund performance, not the return on the single OpenAI stake.

However, Tiger Global must wait for OpenAI’s initial public offering to fully exit the position and realise the gains, and Altman has pushed the IPO timeline out to at least next year. Neither Tiger Global nor OpenAI commented on the matter.

The investment is a morale boost for Tiger Global after a strategic shift following a tech‑stock slump. In 2022, rising rates battered startups, tech stocks plunged and venture‑capital valuations were cut, shrinking assets under management from $100 billion to $50 billion.

Losses across several funds triggered a senior‑leadership reshuffle and prompted the firm to revert to a smaller‑scale, more concentrated‑holding strategy, with Coleman taking tighter control of less‑liquid investments. The firm now manages about $60 billion in assets.

Coleman is also more directly involved in managing the latest venture fund, Private Investment Partners 16, which is $2.7 billion in size – the smallest in roughly a decade – and besides OpenAI also backs Anthropic, self‑driving car firm Waymo and AI startup Temporal Technologies.

OpenAI now ranks among Tiger Global’s most successful investments ever. The firm’s 2010 investment in JD.com (JD‑US) generated over $6.5 billion, and its 2009 bet on Flipkart yielded $3.5 billion. By comparison, the potential $5 billion gain from OpenAI is sizable, but the ultimate outcome will only be confirmed when the stake is actually sold.

items.title: 阿波羅電力與特斯拉簽約採購260台儲能設備 2028投入營運
items.title_en: Apollo Power Signs Deal with Tesla to Purchase 260 Energy Storage Units, Operational in 2028
paras: 阿波羅電力(7911-TW)今(8)日舉行「1GWh大型儲能設備採購簽約暨合作啟動儀式」，與台灣特斯拉(TSLA-US)能源簽署總容量1GWh的Tesla Megapack，總計260台儲能設備，將於2027年底陸續交付，並在2028年投入營運。
董事長王惠民表示，全球大型儲能設備供應吃緊，這批約1GWH的儲能設備是為台灣製造業、醫療機構、科學園區及AI資料中心提前保留關鍵電力資源，將依照市場需期與案場條件分批交付。
王惠民表示，阿波羅將整合綠電PPA、Tesla儲能、UPS、微電網與AI EMS，從系統設計、工程施工到長期維運提供一站式服務，以Equipment Ready、Power Ready、Delivery Ready 3項準備，把設備轉化為企業可依靠的強韌電網。
台灣特斯拉能源事業總經理孫小涵表示，今年6月與群聯(8299-TW)發表示範案場效果，4個月後即走到1GWh規模。而Tesla Energy全球儲能部署已超過50GWh，未來將與阿波羅逐一於案場落地，並提供長達20年的原廠保固與運維服務。
Tesla現場的技術分享則提到，Megapack將PCS與熱管理等子系統整合於單一機櫃，可大幅縮短安裝與試車時間，其Grid-Forming(GFM)技術可同時兼顧穩壓穩頻與功率調度，達到毫秒級響應。在AI資料中心GPU負載案例中，開啟GFM後電網高頻震盪降低約7成，此技術今年6月也已在群聯廠區完成驗證。
阿波羅指出，此計畫總投資金額約130億元，將導入260台儲能裝置，合計容量501MW，連續放電2小時可達1GWh，並將布建於西部產業走廊，與用電大戶行程分散式電廠，預計分3批交貨。
總經理吳俊儀則補充，130億元的投資涵蓋採購儲能裝置成本，以及裝置落地至企業廠區的相關工程費用，其中裝置採購成本約占4至5成。他並指出，目標客戶多樣，包括鋼鐵、半導體、工業製造、紡織及醫療院所等，而目前計畫導入260台中，正式簽約客戶約33台，並有150台正在議約，預計2027年底交付，2028年投入營運。
另外，阿波羅也與群聯、技嘉(2376-TW)、士電(1503-TW)共同啟動「AIDC暨企業強韌電網合作」。
群聯執行長潘建成指出，雙方已從群聯廠區的強韌電網展開合作，運算端以aiDAPTIV+提升效率，能源端由阿波羅整合儲能與EMS。技嘉總經理李宜泰則表示，AIDC的下一個瓶頸已從GPU轉為電力能否及時取得與穩定供應，雙方共同打造從電力到算力的完整方案。
paras_en: Apollo Power (7911-TW) held a "1GWh Large‑Scale Energy Storage Procurement Signing and Cooperation Launch Ceremony" today, signing with Tesla Taiwan (TSLA‑US) Energy for a total capacity of 1 GWh of Tesla Megapack units, amounting to 260 storage devices that will be delivered gradually through the end of 2027 and put into operation in 2028.

Chairman Wang Huimin said global supply of large‑scale energy storage is tight, and this roughly 1 GWh batch is being reserved in advance for Taiwan’s manufacturing, medical institutions, science parks and AI data centers to secure critical power resources, with deliveries staged according to market demand and site conditions.

Wang added that Apollo will integrate green‑power PPAs, Tesla storage, UPS, micro‑grids and AI EMS to provide a one‑stop service from system design and engineering to long‑term operation, using three readiness stages—Equipment Ready, Power Ready and Delivery Ready—to turn the equipment into a resilient grid that enterprises can rely on.

Tesla Energy Taiwan General Manager Sun Xiaohan said that after a pilot site with Phison (8299‑TW) in June demonstrated results, the project scaled to 1 GWh within four months. Tesla Energy’s global storage deployment now exceeds 50 GWh, and it will work with Apollo to implement the solution site by site, offering up to 20 years of factory warranty and operation‑maintenance services.

Technical sharing at the Tesla site highlighted that the Megapack integrates PCS and thermal‑management subsystems into a single rack, greatly shortening installation and commissioning time. Its Grid‑Forming (GFM) technology simultaneously provides voltage/frequency regulation and power dispatch with millisecond‑level response; in an AI data‑center GPU‑load case, enabling GFM reduced high‑frequency grid oscillations by about 70%, a capability validated at Phison’s plant in June this year.

Apollo noted the project’s total investment is about NT$13 billion, covering 260 storage units with a combined capacity of 501 MW that can discharge continuously for two hours to reach 1 GWh. The installations will be built along the western industrial corridor, forming distributed power plants with large electricity users, and are planned to be delivered in three batches.

General Manager Wu Junyi added that the NT$13 billion investment includes both the procurement cost of the storage units and the engineering costs to install them at corporate sites, with the equipment cost accounting for roughly 40‑50% of the total. Target customers span steel, semiconductor, industrial manufacturing, textile and medical sectors; of the 260 units, about 33 have been formally signed, another 150 are under negotiation, with deliveries expected by the end of 2027 and operation starting in 2028.
Apollo also launched the "AIDC and Enterprise Resilient Grid Cooperation" together with Phison, Gigabyte (2376‑TW) and Shidian (1503‑TW).

Phison CEO Pan Jiancheng said the two sides have begun cooperation on a resilient grid at Phison’s facilities, using aiDAPTIV+ on the computing side to boost efficiency while Apollo integrates storage and EMS on the energy side. Gigabyte General Manager Li Yitai noted that the next bottleneck for AIDC has shifted from GPUs to whether power can be obtained timely and reliably, and both parties are jointly creating a complete solution from electricity to compute power.

items.title: 廣越9月、Q3營收均創歷史次高 主要客戶需求仍具支撐
items.title_en: Guangyue's September and Q3 Revenue Reach Record Highs, Core Customer Demand Remains Supportive
paras: 羽絨衣代工大廠廣越(4438-TW)今（8）日公告9月營收25.73億元，年增3.13%；第三季合併營收74.32億元，年增2.21%；累計前三季合併營收153.73億元，年增3.7%，均創歷史次高。
廣越董事長吳朝筆表示，儘管去年旺季營收基期已高，今年品牌客戶訂單仍維持穩健成長，帶動第三季營收再超越去年同期，顯示主要客戶需求仍具支撐。
展望後續營運，廣越指出，公司將以高端機能服飾製造能力與多產地配置為基礎，持續掌握客戶訂單與出貨節奏，並強化生產調度及交付彈性，配合品牌客戶供應鏈需求，深化長期合作關係。
隨第三季營收穩健成長，廣越看好獲利表現，在持續拓展業務的同時，也重視營收成長所帶來的獲利貢獻，將透過提升生產效率、成本控管及資源配置，持續強化經營效益，為長期發展與股東回報奠定基礎。
paras_en: Guangyue (4438-TW), a major OEM of down jackets, announced today (the 8th) that its September revenue was NT$2.573 billion, up 3.13% year‑over‑year; its consolidated Q3 revenue was NT$7.432 billion, up 2.21% year‑over‑year; and its cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$15.373 billion, up 3.7% year‑over‑year, all of which are the second‑highest levels in the company’s history.

Chairman Wu Chaobi said that although last year’s peak season set a high base, this year’s brand‑client orders still grew steadily, pushing Q3 revenue beyond the same period last year and showing that demand from key customers remains supportive.

Looking ahead, Guangyue noted that the company will build on its high‑end functional apparel manufacturing capabilities and diversified production locations to continuously capture client orders and shipment rhythms, while strengthening production scheduling and delivery flexibility to meet brand‑client supply‑chain needs and deepen long‑term partnerships.

With solid Q3 revenue growth, Guangyue is optimistic about profit performance. While expanding its business, it also emphasizes the profit contribution from revenue growth, aiming to enhance operating efficiency, cost control and resource allocation to continuously improve business effectiveness and lay a foundation for long‑term development and shareholder returns.

paras_en: Taiwan stocks on the 8th opened volatile and closed lower amid selling pressure ahead of the Double‑Ten holiday and a correction in U.S. markets. The index fell 492 points to finish at 49,313, with turnover shrinking to NT$8.696 trillion. Post‑market data show foreign investors sold out for three consecutive days, dumping a massive NT$75.852 billion in a single day, chiefly offloading the ETF Uni-President Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) and AU Optronics (2409‑TW) at about 59,000 contracts each, and also selling 25,000 contracts of Foxconn.

In total, the three major institutional groups sold NT$89.895 billion on the day, with foreign investors accounting for NT$75.852 billion of that three‑day streak. Proprietary traders sold NT$18.73 billion, while investment trusts bucked the trend and bought NT$4.688 billion. On the futures side, foreign investors increased short positions by 4,048 contracts, bringing their cumulative short exposure to 83,000 contracts.

Among the top ten stocks bought by foreign investors, five were traditional‑industry names. The biggest buy was Uni-President Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) with 30,000 contracts, followed by Nanya Technology (21,700 contracts), Sinopec (21,600 contracts), Wistron (15,500 contracts), Formosa Plastics (14,200 contracts), China Steel (10,300 contracts), Taiwan Cement (10,100 contracts), Mega Financial (10,100 contracts), Guo Qiao (8,931 contracts) and FT Taiwan Sustainable High‑Yield (00961‑TW) with 8,268 contracts.

In the foreign investors’ top ten sellers, the ETF Uni‑President Taiwan Yield (00406A) and panel maker AU Optronics led with 59,400 contracts each. They were followed by Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) with 51,000 contracts, KGI Taiwan TOP 50 (009816‑TW) with 38,700 contracts, Foxconn with 25,600 contracts, Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield with 22,400 contracts, Powerchip Semiconductor with 21,600 contracts, Taishin Shin Kong Financial with 21,300 contracts, Innolux with 20,500 contracts, UMC with 19,700 contracts, and a large sell of TSMC at 12,300 contracts.

Among investment trusts, the top ten net‑buy stocks were dominated by financials (five slots). The biggest net buy was Formosa Petrochemical with 14,800 contracts, followed by Formosa Plastics (13,900 contracts), Taishin Shin Kong Financial (8,156 contracts), KGI Fund (3,515 contracts), CTBC Financial (3,186 contracts), Da‑Cheng Steel (2,989 contracts), Fubon Financial (2,844 contracts), Cathay Financial (2,832 contracts), Uni‑President (1,911 contracts) and UMC (1,605 contracts).

The top ten net‑sell stocks for investment trusts were led by Jing Yuan Electronics with 8,530 contracts, followed by Mega Financial (5,228 contracts), Taiwan High Speed Rail (2,348 contracts), Nomura Taiwan Select (2,120 contracts), Chih Shen (1,234 contracts), Maolian‑KY (1,116 contracts), Yageo (1,038 contracts), ASE Technology Holding (1,034 contracts), and then Xinxing and Qiang Mao.

Institutional commentary noted that, from a technical standpoint, today’s decline came with reduced volume and the index is holding above the October 5 low of 48,574 points, which has not been broken on high volume. In the short term, the pull‑back can still be viewed optimistically. Foreign investors remain pessimistic in both futures and spot markets, and overall positioning is being treated conservatively.

items.title: 水資源挑戰升溫 貿協10/15邀專家探解方、聚焦AI水處理到產業實務
items.title_en: Water Resource Challenges Heat Up: Trade Association Invites Experts on Oct 15 to Explore Solutions, Focuses on AI Water Treatment and Industry Practices
paras: 面對極端氣候、新興污染物及水資源等挑戰，全球水資源議題升溫，為協助產業掌握趨勢與創新解方，貿協將於下周10月15日於南港展覽館舉辦「2026年全球水資源永續論壇」，匯聚國內外水資源專家及產業代表，聚焦PFAS政策、AI水處理、水資源再生、工業水循環及洪水風險管理等議題，從政策、科技到產業實務，探討高用水產業面對水資源挑戰的因應之道。
貿協表示，本次論壇邀請三位國際水資源及氣候韌性領域專家，分享全球水資源永續發展趨勢，三位講者分別從水資源再生、洪水防護及AI技術切入，呈現全球水資源永續與氣候韌性的最新發展。
貿協指出，PFAS等新興污染物已成為全球水質管理的重要議題，論壇邀請環境部化學物質管理署及美國水質協會(WQA)，分別從台灣政策及美國法規發展的角度，解析PFAS風險管理與國際法規趨勢，協助業者掌握水質管理挑戰及國際市場對污染物管理與水質安全的要求。
在科技創新與產業應用方面，經濟部水利署將分享水利工程減碳推動成果，臥龍智慧環境說明AI水處理技術的跨產業應用，中宇環保工程則介紹工業水循環實務案例，探討科技如何提升用水效率、降低環境衝擊，加速企業邁向水資源永續轉型。
貿協表示，水資源管理已不只是環境議題，更與企業營運韌性、成本管理及國際市場競爭力密切相關，本次論壇串聯政府、國際組織、技術供應商及高用水產業，促進跨域交流與國際合作，協助台灣產業掌握全球發展趨勢，尋找符合自身需求的解方。
paras_en: Facing extreme climate, emerging pollutants and water resource challenges, global water issues are heating up. To help industry grasp trends and innovative solutions, the Trade Association will hold the “2026 Global Water Resource Sustainability Forum” on October 15 at the Nangang Exhibition Hall, gathering domestic and international water experts and industry representatives to focus on PFAS policy, AI water treatment, water resource regeneration, industrial water recycling and flood risk management, discussing responses from policy, technology to practical industry for high‑water‑use sectors confronting water challenges.

The Trade Association said the forum will invite three international experts in water resources and climate resilience to share global sustainable water development trends. The speakers will address water regeneration, flood protection and AI technology, presenting the latest developments in sustainable water and climate resilience worldwide.

The Trade Association noted that emerging pollutants such as PFAS have become a key issue in global water quality management. The forum invites Taiwan’s Environmental Protection Administration Chemical Substances Management Office and the U.S. Water Quality Association (WQA) to analyze PFAS risk management and international regulatory trends from the perspectives of Taiwanese policy and U.S. regulations, helping businesses understand water quality challenges and international market requirements for pollutant control and water safety.

Regarding technological innovation and industrial application, the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Water Resources Agency will share achievements in carbon‑reduction water engineering, Wolong Smart Environment will explain cross‑industry AI water‑treatment technology, and Zhongyu Environmental Engineering will present practical cases of industrial water recycling, exploring how technology can boost water‑use efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and accelerate corporate transition to sustainable water management.

The Trade Association stated that water resource management is no longer just an environmental issue; it is closely tied to corporate operational resilience, cost management and international competitiveness. The forum links government, international organizations, technology providers and high‑water‑use industries to promote cross‑sector dialogue and international cooperation, helping Taiwanese firms keep pace with global trends and find solutions that meet their specific needs.

items.title: 韋僑9月營收創歷史次高、Q3營收連創新高 全年營收再突破
items.title_en: Wei Chiao September Revenue Hits Historical Second‑Highest, Q3 Revenue Sets New High, Full‑Year Revenue Breaks Through
paras: RFID 解決方案供應商韋僑 (6417-TW) 遷入新廠的綜效正在高度發揮，且醫療應用需求回升挹注，單季營收已在 2025 年第四季起連續3季創新高，韋僑今(8)日公布9月營收1.72億元改寫歷史次高，月增0.67%，年增18.26%，第三季營收5.1億元再創新高，年增25.85%。
韋僑2026年前三季營收14.44億元，年增22.08%，再創同期新高，全年營收將改寫新高。韋僑2026年1-9月營收14.44億元，年增幅達22.08%。第四季營運也有再向上突破的契機，法人估韋僑2026年下半年的單月平均營收將在1.7億元之上。

韋僑在2026年第二季營收以 5.06 億元續改寫歷史新高， 2026 年第二季營收 5.06 億元，創新高，毛利率 34.71%，季增 0.14 個百分點，年增 3.43 個百分點，單季稅後純益以 8204 萬元創新高，季增 15.89%，年增 2.01 倍，每股純益 1.94 元優於預期。韋僑 2026 年上半年營收 9.34 億元，毛利率 34.65%，年增 2.85 個百分點，稅後純益 1.53 億元，年增 89.13%，每股純益 3.62 元。
在韋僑推出於 Ambient IoT 的 BLE TAG 新產品，預計在下半年出貨將呈現倍數成長同時，下半年估單月業績也平均達 1.7 億元。同時以韋僑的訂單及出貨而言，2026 年第三季可望續創新高。全年營收將突破 2025 年營收歷史新高的 16.07 億元水準。
同時，韋僑在積極開創海外新布局同時，法人估 2026 年全年上看每股純益 7-7.5 元，同時，韋僑在 2027 年力拼賺回一個股本。
韋僑的無線射頻 RFID 解決方案醫療應用需求正在明顯回升，同時，在韋僑科技預計將進一步在大股東希華 (2484-TW) 的全力協助開拓日本市場，在日本設立生產線以在地法人型態搶攻境內醫、藥品界對 RFID 解決方案需求。韋僑科技對於赴日本龐大醫藥市場的 RFID 解決方案生產，預計在 2028 年進入量產。
paras_en: RFID solutions provider Wei Chiao (6417‑TW) is reaping the synergies of moving into its new plant, and a rebound in medical‑application demand is boosting sales. Quarterly revenue has set new records for three consecutive quarters starting in Q4 2025. On the 8th, Wei Chiao reported September revenue of NT$172 million, a historic second‑highest figure, up 0.67% month‑over‑month and 18.26% year‑over‑year. Q3 revenue reached NT$510 million, a new high, up 25.85% year‑over‑year.

Wei Chiao posted revenue of NT$1.444 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, a 22.08% year‑over‑year increase and a new peak for the period, indicating that full‑year revenue will set a new record. The company’s fourth‑quarter operations also have upside, with analysts estimating that average monthly revenue in the second half of 2026 will exceed NT$170 million.

In Q2 2026, Wei Chiao’s revenue rose to NT$506 million, again a historic high, with a gross margin of 34.71%, up 0.14 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.43 points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax hit NT$82.04 million, a new high, up 15.89% quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.01‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$1.94, beating expectations. For the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$934 million, gross margin 34.65% (up 2.85 points YoY), net profit NT$153 million (up 89.13% YoY), and EPS NT$3.62.

Wei Chiao’s newly launched BLE TAG product for Ambient IoT is expected to see multiple‑fold shipment growth in the second half of the year, with average monthly sales projected at NT$170 million. Based on its order and shipment pipeline, Q3 2026 is also expected to set a new high, and full‑year revenue is projected to surpass the 2025 record level of NT$1.607 billion.
Analysts estimate that Wei Chiao’s full‑year 2026 earnings per share could reach NT$7.0‑7.5, while the company is actively expanding overseas and aims to recoup one share‑capital unit in 2027.

Demand for Wei Chiao’s wireless RFID solutions in medical applications is clearly rebounding. With strong support from major shareholder Xi‑Hua (2484‑TW), the company plans to establish a production line in Japan to serve the domestic medical and pharmaceutical markets there. Production for the Japanese RFID solution market is slated to enter mass production in 2028.

items.title: 阿波羅電力與特斯拉簽約採購260台儲能設備 2028投入營運
items.title_en: Apollo Power Signs Deal with Tesla to Purchase 260 Energy Storage Units, Operational in 2028
paras: 阿波羅電力(7911-TW)今(8)日舉行「1GWh大型儲能設備採購簽約暨合作啟動儀式」，與台灣特斯拉(TSLA-US)能源簽署總容量1GWh的Tesla Megapack，總計260台儲能設備，將於2027年底陸續交付，並在2028年投入營運。
董事長王惠民表示，全球大型儲能設備供應吃緊，這批約1GWH的儲能設備是為台灣製造業、醫療機構、科學園區及AI資料中心提前保留關鍵電力資源，將依照市場需期與案場條件分批交付。
王惠民表示，阿波羅將整合綠電PPA、Tesla儲能、UPS、微電網與AI EMS，從系統設計、工程施工到長期維運提供一站式服務，以Equipment Ready、Power Ready、Delivery Ready 3項準備，把設備轉化為企業可依靠的強韌電網。
台灣特斯拉能源事業總經理孫小涵表示，今年6月與群聯(8299-TW)發表示範案場效果，4個月後即走到1GWh規模。而Tesla Energy全球儲能部署已超過50GWh，未來將與阿波羅逐一於案場落地，並提供長達20年的原廠保固與運維服務。
Tesla現場的技術分享則提到，Megapack將PCS與熱管理等子系統整合於單一機櫃，可大幅縮短安裝與試車時間，其Grid-Forming(GFM)技術可同時兼顧穩壓穩頻與功率調度，達到毫秒級響應。在AI資料中心GPU負載案例中，開啟GFM後電網高頻震盪降低約7成，此技術今年6月也已在群聯廠區完成驗證。
阿波羅指出，此計畫總投資金額約130億元，將導入260台儲能裝置，合計容量501MW，連續放電2小時可達1GWh，並將布建於西部產業走廊，與用電大戶行程分散式電廠，預計分3批交貨。
總經理吳俊儀則補充，130億元的投資涵蓋採購儲能裝置成本，以及裝置落地至企業廠區的相關工程費用，其中裝置採購成本約占4至5成。他並指出，目標客戶多樣，包括鋼鐵、半導體、工業製造、紡織及醫療院所等，而目前計畫導入260台中，正式簽約客戶約33台，並有150台正在議約，預計2027年底交付，2028年投入營運。
另外，阿波羅也與群聯、技嘉(2376-TW)、士電(1503-TW)共同啟動「AIDC暨企業強韌電網合作」。
群聯執行長潘建成指出，雙方已從群聯廠區的強韌電網展開合作，運算端以aiDAPTIV+提升效率，能源端由阿波羅整合儲能與EMS。技嘉總經理李宜泰則表示，AIDC的下一個瓶頸已從GPU轉為電力能否及時取得與穩定供應，雙方共同打造從電力到算力的完整方案。
paras_en: Apollo Power (7911-TW) held a "1GWh Large‑Scale Energy Storage Procurement Signing and Cooperation Launch Ceremony" today, signing with Tesla Taiwan (TSLA‑US) Energy for a total capacity of 1 GWh of Tesla Megapack units, amounting to 260 storage devices that will be delivered gradually through the end of 2027 and put into operation in 2028.

Chairman Wang Huimin said global supply of large‑scale energy storage is tight, and this roughly 1 GWh batch is being reserved in advance for Taiwan’s manufacturing, medical institutions, science parks and AI data centers to secure critical power resources, with deliveries staged according to market demand and site conditions.

Wang added that Apollo will integrate green‑power PPAs, Tesla storage, UPS, micro‑grids and AI EMS to provide a one‑stop service from system design and engineering to long‑term operation, using three readiness stages—Equipment Ready, Power Ready and Delivery Ready—to turn the equipment into a resilient grid that enterprises can rely on.

Tesla Energy Taiwan General Manager Sun Xiaohan said that after a pilot site with Phison (8299‑TW) in June demonstrated results, the project scaled to 1 GWh within four months. Tesla Energy’s global storage deployment now exceeds 50 GWh, and it will work with Apollo to implement the solution site by site, offering up to 20 years of factory warranty and operation‑maintenance services.

Technical sharing at the Tesla site highlighted that the Megapack integrates PCS and thermal‑management subsystems into a single rack, greatly shortening installation and commissioning time. Its Grid‑Forming (GFM) technology simultaneously provides voltage/frequency regulation and power dispatch with millisecond‑level response; in an AI data‑center GPU‑load case, enabling GFM reduced high‑frequency grid oscillations by about 70%, a capability validated at Phison’s plant in June this year.

Apollo noted the project’s total investment is about NT$13 billion, covering 260 storage units with a combined capacity of 501 MW that can discharge continuously for two hours to reach 1 GWh. The installations will be built along the western industrial corridor, forming distributed power plants with large electricity users, and are planned to be delivered in three batches.

General Manager Wu Junyi added that the NT$13 billion investment includes both the procurement cost of the storage units and the engineering costs to install them at corporate sites, with the equipment cost accounting for roughly 40‑50% of the total. Target customers span steel, semiconductor, industrial manufacturing, textile and medical sectors; of the 260 units, about 33 have been formally signed, another 150 are under negotiation, with deliveries expected by the end of 2027 and operation starting in 2028.
Apollo also launched the "AIDC and Enterprise Resilient Grid Cooperation" together with Phison, Gigabyte (2376‑TW) and Shidian (1503‑TW).

Phison CEO Pan Jiancheng said the two sides have begun cooperation on a resilient grid at Phison’s facilities, using aiDAPTIV+ on the computing side to boost efficiency while Apollo integrates storage and EMS on the energy side. Gigabyte General Manager Li Yitai noted that the next bottleneck for AIDC has shifted from GPUs to whether power can be obtained timely and reliably, and both parties are jointly creating a complete solution from electricity to compute power.

items.title: 廣越9月、Q3營收均創歷史次高 主要客戶需求仍具支撐
items.title_en: Guangyue's September and Q3 Revenue Reach Record Highs, Core Customer Demand Remains Supportive
paras: 羽絨衣代工大廠廣越(4438-TW)今（8）日公告9月營收25.73億元，年增3.13%；第三季合併營收74.32億元，年增2.21%；累計前三季合併營收153.73億元，年增3.7%，均創歷史次高。
廣越董事長吳朝筆表示，儘管去年旺季營收基期已高，今年品牌客戶訂單仍維持穩健成長，帶動第三季營收再超越去年同期，顯示主要客戶需求仍具支撐。
展望後續營運，廣越指出，公司將以高端機能服飾製造能力與多產地配置為基礎，持續掌握客戶訂單與出貨節奏，並強化生產調度及交付彈性，配合品牌客戶供應鏈需求，深化長期合作關係。
隨第三季營收穩健成長，廣越看好獲利表現，在持續拓展業務的同時，也重視營收成長所帶來的獲利貢獻，將透過提升生產效率、成本控管及資源配置，持續強化經營效益，為長期發展與股東回報奠定基礎。
paras_en: Guangyue (4438-TW), a major OEM of down jackets, announced today (the 8th) that its September revenue was NT$2.573 billion, up 3.13% year‑over‑year; its consolidated Q3 revenue was NT$7.432 billion, up 2.21% year‑over‑year; and its cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$15.373 billion, up 3.7% year‑over‑year, all of which are the second‑highest levels in the company’s history.

Chairman Wu Chaobi said that although last year’s peak season set a high base, this year’s brand‑client orders still grew steadily, pushing Q3 revenue beyond the same period last year and showing that demand from key customers remains supportive.

Looking ahead, Guangyue noted that the company will build on its high‑end functional apparel manufacturing capabilities and diversified production locations to continuously capture client orders and shipment rhythms, while strengthening production scheduling and delivery flexibility to meet brand‑client supply‑chain needs and deepen long‑term partnerships.

With solid Q3 revenue growth, Guangyue is optimistic about profit performance. While expanding its business, it also emphasizes the profit contribution from revenue growth, aiming to enhance operating efficiency, cost control and resource allocation to continuously improve business effectiveness and lay a foundation for long‑term development and shareholder returns.

paras: 台股今(8)日受雙十連假前賣壓及美股修正影響，開盤隨即呈現震盪收黑格局，終場下跌492點，收49,313點，成交量縮減至8,696億元，據盤後資訊顯示，外資連3日賣超，單日大砍758.52億元，大賣ETF主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)、友達(2409-TW)各5.9萬張最高，也倒貨鴻海2.5萬張。

法人表示，指數從技術面上觀察，今日下跌量縮，目前在台股10月5日低點(48,574點)不被放量跌破下，短線台股拉回仍可以樂觀看待。外資在期現貨上皆悲觀布局，整體籌碼面保守看待。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks on the 8th opened volatile and closed lower amid selling pressure ahead of the Double‑Ten holiday and a correction in U.S. markets. The index fell 492 points to finish at 49,313, with turnover shrinking to NT$8.696 trillion. Post‑market data show foreign investors sold out for three consecutive days, dumping a massive NT$75.852 billion in a single day, chiefly offloading the ETF Uni-President Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) and AU Optronics (2409‑TW) at about 59,000 contracts each, and also selling 25,000 contracts of Foxconn.

In total, the three major institutional groups sold NT$89.895 billion on the day, with foreign investors accounting for NT$75.852 billion of that three‑day streak. Proprietary traders sold NT$18.73 billion, while investment trusts bucked the trend and bought NT$4.688 billion. On the futures side, foreign investors increased short positions by 4,048 contracts, bringing their cumulative short exposure to 83,000 contracts.

Among the top ten stocks bought by foreign investors, five were traditional‑industry names. The biggest buy was Uni-President Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) with 30,000 contracts, followed by Nanya Technology (21,700 contracts), Sinopec (21,600 contracts), Wistron (15,500 contracts), Formosa Plastics (14,200 contracts), China Steel (10,300 contracts), Taiwan Cement (10,100 contracts), Mega Financial (10,100 contracts), Guo Qiao (8,931 contracts) and FT Taiwan Sustainable High‑Yield (00961‑TW) with 8,268 contracts.

In the foreign investors’ top ten sellers, the ETF Uni‑President Taiwan Yield (00406A) and panel maker AU Optronics led with 59,400 contracts each. They were followed by Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) with 51,000 contracts, KGI Taiwan TOP 50 (009816‑TW) with 38,700 contracts, Foxconn with 25,600 contracts, Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield with 22,400 contracts, Powerchip Semiconductor with 21,600 contracts, Taishin Shin Kong Financial with 21,300 contracts, Innolux with 20,500 contracts, UMC with 19,700 contracts, and a large sell of TSMC at 12,300 contracts.

Among investment trusts, the top ten net‑buy stocks were dominated by financials (five slots). The biggest net buy was Formosa Petrochemical with 14,800 contracts, followed by Formosa Plastics (13,900 contracts), Taishin Shin Kong Financial (8,156 contracts), KGI Fund (3,515 contracts), CTBC Financial (3,186 contracts), Da‑Cheng Steel (2,989 contracts), Fubon Financial (2,844 contracts), Cathay Financial (2,832 contracts), Uni‑President (1,911 contracts) and UMC (1,605 contracts).

The top ten net‑sell stocks for investment trusts were led by Jing Yuan Electronics with 8,530 contracts, followed by Mega Financial (5,228 contracts), Taiwan High Speed Rail (2,348 contracts), Nomura Taiwan Select (2,120 contracts), Chih Shen (1,234 contracts), Maolian‑KY (1,116 contracts), Yageo (1,038 contracts), ASE Technology Holding (1,034 contracts), and then Xinxing and Qiang Mao.

Institutional commentary noted that, from a technical standpoint, today’s decline came with reduced volume and the index is holding above the October 5 low of 48,574 points, which has not been broken on high volume. In the short term, the pull‑back can still be viewed optimistically. Foreign investors remain pessimistic in both futures and spot markets, and overall positioning is being treated conservatively.
