items.title: ChatGPT還沒問世就出手！老虎環球押對OpenAI 帳面獲利上看50億美元
items.title_en: Tiger Global Bet on OpenAI Before ChatGPT Launched, Eyeing $5 B Paper Profit
paras: 在ChatGPT問世前一年，老虎環球(Tiger Global)便押注OpenAI，如今這筆早期投資有望帶來50億美元帳面獲利，成為該公司成立25年來最成功的投資之一，也為這家曾遭科技股重挫打擊的投資機構扳回一城。
據《彭博》周四(8日)報導，OpenAI正洽談以1.4兆美元估值募資300億美元。知情人士透露，若以此估值計算，老虎環球持股的潛在獲利可達50億美元，但仍屬尚未實現的帳面收益。

ChatGPT問世前搶先布局 早期押注推升基金表現

2021年，OpenAI共同創辦人暨執行長阿特曼致電老虎環球創辦人柯爾曼(Chase Coleman)，邀請他以157億美元估值，成為少數投資OpenAI的機構投資人之一。當時距離ChatGPT公開推出還有一年，多數大型投資人尚未察覺其潛力。
老虎環球當年同意投入1.5億美元，之後多次加碼，並成為首家投資OpenAI的避險基金。隨著ChatGPT於2022年爆紅並掀起AI軍備競賽，這筆提前布局的投資開始展現成果。
知情人士指出，OpenAI投資已帶動老虎環球旗下避險基金，以及同時投資上市與未上市公司的基金，今年前九個月分別上漲9.4%與19.3%。
OpenAI也是老虎環球最新一期創投基金的最大持股之一。截至6月30日，該基金未扣費用的內部報酬率(IRR)達65%，扣除費用後為44%。這些數字反映整體基金表現，並非單筆OpenAI投資報酬率。
不過，老虎環球仍須等到OpenAI首次公開發行(IPO)，才能完全出脫持股、實現收益，而阿特曼已將上市時程延至至少明年。老虎環球與OpenAI均不予置評。

科技股重挫後調整策略 聚焦規模較小的集中投資

這筆投資對老虎環球具有重振旗鼓的意義。2022年，利率攀升重創新創企業，科技股大跌與創投資產估值下修，使其管理資產由1,000億美元驟降至500億美元。
旗下多檔基金虧損引發高層改組，也促使公司回歸規模較小、持股更集中的投資策略，由柯爾曼加強掌管流動性較低的投資。目前公司管理資產約600億美元。
柯爾曼也更直接參與最新創投基金Private Investment Partners 16的管理。該基金規模27億美元，為約十年來最小，除OpenAI外，也投資Anthropic、自駕車公司Waymo與AI新創Temporal Technologies。
OpenAI如今可望躋身老虎環球歷來最成功的投資之列。該公司2010年投資京東(JD-US)(09618-HK)，曾獲利逾65億美元；2009年押注Flipkart，則帶來35億美元收益。相較之下，OpenAI的50億美元潛在獲利雖相當可觀，最終成果仍待實際退出時驗證。
paras_en: A year before ChatGPT debuted, Tiger Global placed a bet on OpenAI, and the early stake now looks set to generate a $5 billion paper gain – one of the firm’s most successful investments in its 25‑year history and a comeback for the firm that was hit hard by a tech‑stock rout.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday (the 8th), OpenAI is in talks to raise $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Sources said that at that valuation Tiger Global’s holding could be worth about $5 billion in potential profit, though the gain remains unrealised on paper.

Tiger Global’s early positioning before ChatGPT’s launch boosted fund performance. In 2021, OpenAI co‑founder and CEO Sam Altman called Tiger Global founder Chase Coleman and invited him to invest at a $15.7 billion valuation, making Tiger one of the few institutional investors in OpenAI. At the time, ChatGPT was still a year away from public release and most large investors had not yet recognised its potential.

Tiger Global agreed to put in $150 million that year and later added to the stake, becoming the first hedge fund to back OpenAI. As ChatGPT went viral in 2022 and sparked an AI arms race, the pre‑emptive investment began to pay off.

Sources said OpenAI’s investment has lifted Tiger Global’s hedge‑fund arm as well as its funds that invest in both listed and private companies, which rose 9.4% and 19.3% respectively in the first nine months of this year.

OpenAI is also one of the largest holdings in Tiger Global’s latest venture fund. As of June 30, the fund’s internal rate of return (IRR) was 65% before fees and 44% after fees – figures that reflect overall fund performance, not the return on the single OpenAI stake.

However, Tiger Global must wait for OpenAI’s initial public offering to fully exit the position and realise the gains, and Altman has pushed the IPO timeline out to at least next year. Neither Tiger Global nor OpenAI commented on the matter.

The investment is a morale boost for Tiger Global after a strategic shift following a tech‑stock slump. In 2022, rising rates battered startups, tech stocks plunged and venture‑capital valuations were cut, shrinking assets under management from $100 billion to $50 billion.

Losses across several funds triggered a senior‑leadership reshuffle and prompted the firm to revert to a smaller‑scale, more concentrated‑holding strategy, with Coleman taking tighter control of less‑liquid investments. The firm now manages about $60 billion in assets.

Coleman is also more directly involved in managing the latest venture fund, Private Investment Partners 16, which is $2.7 billion in size – the smallest in roughly a decade – and besides OpenAI also backs Anthropic, self‑driving car firm Waymo and AI startup Temporal Technologies.

OpenAI now ranks among Tiger Global’s most successful investments ever. The firm’s 2010 investment in JD.com (JD‑US) generated over $6.5 billion, and its 2009 bet on Flipkart yielded $3.5 billion. By comparison, the potential $5 billion gain from OpenAI is sizable, but the ultimate outcome will only be confirmed when the stake is actually sold.

items.title: 聯準會理事華勒：仍需升息 但可以有靈活性
items.title_en: Fed Governor Waller: More Rate Hikes Needed but Flexibility Is Possible
paras: 美國聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(8日)指出，若後續經濟數據符合預期，聯準會未來仍可能需要進一步升息，以確保通膨率順利回落至 2% 的政策目標。
不過華勒強調，升息步調具備「靈活性」，不一定需要在連續的會議上推動，只要在合理的時間內完成即可，這為 10 月會議暫停升息保留了空間。
華勒的最新表態呼應了近期多位官員的立場，市場預期聯準會將在 10 月 27 日至 28 日的會議上，將政策利率維持在 3.75% 至 4% 的區間不變。
聯準會在 9 月已升息 1 碼(0.25 個百分點)，且多數官員預估年底前還會再升息 1 碼。目前投資人普遍認為，聯準會將在國會期中選舉前一周的 10 月會議按兵不動，並於 12 月 8 日至 9 日的決策會議上再度升息。
對於支持繼續調升利率的理由，華勒分析，今年下半年經濟活動強勁，加上伊朗戰爭帶來的能源價格衝擊未解，以及人工智慧(AI)擴展增加對關鍵商品與服務的需求，皆推升了通膨壓力。他並不擔心貨幣緊縮會引發嚴重的經濟衰退，但擔心近期通膨加速會導致消費者、投資人與企業上調對未來的通膨預期。
此外，在聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)傾向減少政策指引的情況下，華勒則強調適度溝通的重要性。他認為，官員向市場傳達可能的利率走向，有助於錨定短期利率路徑，並能根據新公布的數據靈活調整升息節奏，可避免市場因缺乏訊號而產生劇烈波動。
paras_en: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday (the 8th) that if upcoming economic data come in line with expectations, the Fed may still need to raise rates further to ensure inflation falls back to the 2% policy target.

However, Waller stressed that the pace of rate hikes can be "flexible" and does not have to occur at consecutive meetings; it only needs to be completed within a reasonable time frame, leaving room to pause hikes at the October meeting.
Waller’s latest remarks echo the stance of several other officials recently, and the market expects the Fed to keep the policy rate unchanged in the Oct. 27‑28 meeting, staying in the 3.75%‑4% range.

The Fed already raised rates by one quarter‑point in September, and most officials project another 0.25‑point hike before year‑end. Investors generally think the Fed will hold steady at the October meeting, a week before the mid‑term elections, and then raise rates again at the Dec. 8‑9 decision meeting.

Regarding the case for further tightening, Waller noted that strong economic activity in the second half of the year, the unresolved energy‑price shock from the Iran war, and AI‑driven demand for key goods and services are all pushing inflation pressures higher. He is not worried that monetary tightening will trigger a severe recession, but he is concerned that accelerating inflation could cause consumers, investors and firms to raise their inflation expectations for the future.

Moreover, with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh leaning toward less policy guidance, Waller emphasized the importance of moderate communication. He believes that officials signaling possible rate paths helps anchor short‑term rate expectations and allows the pace of hikes to be adjusted flexibly as new data arrive, avoiding sharp market volatility from a lack of signals.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆20多年高！資金湧向AI巨頭避險重創小型股  羅素2000跌快10%接近修正區間
items.title_en: US Treasury Yields Surge to 20‑Year High! Funds Rush to AI Giants, Hedge Hits Small Caps; Russell 2000 Down Almost 10% Near Correction Zone
paras: 在投資者熱情重返少數科技巨頭之際，小型股卻在利率重壓下節節敗退。標普500指數今年表現在本周超車羅素2000指數，凸顯市場分化加劇。隨著市場廣度惡化，利率與AI資本開支週期正主導資金流向。
羅素2000指數周三(7日)收於2793.2點，較不到兩個月前歷史收盤高位回落9%，距離較近期高點下跌10%的「修正區間」僅一步之遙，若周四(8日)收於2761.58點便正式步入該區間。
羅素2000今年迄今漲幅12.5%，落後標普的14%，與數周前相比急劇逆轉。
Truist首席投資官Keith Lerner指出，推升小型股走跌的「首要因素」是不斷攀升的長債殖利率。「利率上升正在產生衝擊，只是科技板塊掩蓋了這一影響。」
過去一個月，對利率敏感的金融、房地產族群跌幅均超過7%，材料與工業類股也跌超4%。小型股對利率更為敏感，因其背負更多債務且浮動利率債務佔比高。通膨擔憂、油價上漲及財政赤字擴大推高債券殖利率，加劇小型股估值與再融資壓力。
相比之下，包括科技「七巨頭」在內的超大型個股對利率變化幾乎免疫，儘管它們為AI建設大舉舉債，資金仍湧入這些盈利穩健的避風港。
值得注意的是，即便側重科技的小型股也舉步維艱。Invesco標普小型資訊科技ETF較6月高點跌10.4%。
盈透證券策略師Steve Sosnick說，經濟成長不均衡，加上利率大幅回升，小型股環境艱難。
周三公佈的聯準會(Fed)上月會議記錄顯示，多數官員認為年底前再升息1碼可能是合適的。美股三大指數當日收低，羅素2000大跌1.3%，標普與那指微跌0.2%，道指跌0.7%。
paras_en: As investor enthusiasm returns to a handful of tech giants, small‑cap stocks are retreating under heavy rate pressure. The S&P 500 outperformed the Russell 2000 this week, highlighting growing market divergence. With market breadth deteriorating, the rate cycle and AI capital‑expenditure cycle are now steering capital flows.

The Russell 2000 closed at 2,793.2 points on Wednesday (the 7th), a 9% drop from its historic closing high less than two months ago and just a step away from the “correction zone” defined as a 10% decline from its recent peak. If it closes at 2,761.58 points on Thursday (the 8th), it will officially enter that zone.
The Russell 2000 is up 12.5% year‑to‑date, lagging the S&P’s 14% gain and marking a sharp reversal from a few weeks ago.

Truist Chief Investment Officer Keith Lerner said the “primary factor” driving small‑cap declines is the continuously rising long‑term bond yields. “Rising rates are having an impact, it’s just that the tech sector is masking it,” he noted.

Over the past month, rate‑sensitive financials and real‑estate groups have each fallen more than 7%, while materials and industrial stocks have dropped over 4%. Small caps are even more rate‑sensitive because they carry more debt and a higher proportion of floating‑rate liabilities. Inflation worries, higher oil prices and expanding fiscal deficits have pushed bond yields higher, intensifying valuation and refinancing pressure on small caps.

In contrast, mega‑cap stocks—including the “big seven” tech giants—are virtually immune to rate changes, even as they borrow heavily to fund AI investments, with capital still flowing into these profit‑stable safe havens.
It is noteworthy that even tech‑focused small caps are struggling. The Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF is down 10.4% from its June high.
Interactive Brokers strategist Steve Sosnick said uneven economic growth combined with a sharp rate rise makes the environment tough for small caps.

Federal Reserve minutes released on Wednesday showed most officials think another 0.25‑percentage‑point hike before year‑end could be appropriate. All three major US indexes closed lower that day, with the Russell 2000 plunging 1.3%, the S&P and Nasdaq slipping 0.2%, and the Dow falling 0.7%.

items.title: 亞馬遜零售部門展開新一輪裁員 人數少於1000人
items.title_en: Amazon Retail Division Launches New Round of Layoffs, Fewer Than 1,000 Employees
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周三(7日)證實展開新一輪裁員，主要集中在負責管理主要電商網站的零售(Stores)部門。
據知情人士透露，本次受影響的白領員工少於 1,000 人，範圍涵蓋美國、英國與印度的客戶服務、賣家夥伴服務以及零售業務相關的工程職務。這波裁員時間點恰逢亞馬遜一年一度的大型促銷活動「Prime Big Deal Days」，引發外界關注。
針對本次業務調整，亞馬遜發言人於電子郵件聲明中指出：「我們對 Stores 業務的部分環節進行了調整，因為我們相信這種架構將更有助於我們推進業務重點。」
此外，亞馬遜創辦人兼執行董事長貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)在Fox News播出的專訪中提到，持續裁員是必要的，原因在於公司於疫情期間過度招聘。貝佐斯表示：「當時人們待在家中購物，對我們來說是一段極具壓力的時期……全體團隊非常努力，但我們確實過度擴張了員工員額。」
這項決定也是執行長賈西(Andy Jassy)推動精簡管理層級與降低成本計畫的一部分，亞馬遜自去年底至今年 1 月已累計裁減約 3 萬名企業員工。
裁員消息發布後，亞馬遜內部擁有近 3.7 萬名成員的 Slack 頻道隨即引發熱烈討論，員工紛紛詢問資遣費計算、內部職缺申請權限，以及是否會有下一波裁員通知。另一方面，儘管精簡零售部門，亞馬遜正將資金與人才重新投資於人工智慧(AI)基礎建設與 AWS 雲端業務，甚至主動聯繫先前受裁員影響的前員工，邀請其應徵 AI 相關職缺，展現出科技業整體資源重劃的趨勢。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) confirmed on Wednesday (the 7th) that it is initiating a new round of layoffs, primarily focused on the Retail (Stores) division that manages its main e‑commerce sites.

According to sources, fewer than 1,000 white‑collar staff are affected, covering customer service, seller‑partner services and engineering roles related to retail operations in the United States, the United Kingdom and India. The timing coincides with Amazon’s annual large‑scale promotion event “Prime Big Deal Days,” drawing external attention.

In an email statement, an Amazon spokesperson said regarding the business adjustment: “We have made changes to certain parts of the Stores business because we believe this structure will better help us advance our strategic priorities.”

Additionally, Amazon founder and executive chairman Jeff Bezos told Fox News in an interview that ongoing layoffs are necessary because the company over‑hired during the pandemic. Bezos said, “People were staying home and shopping, which was an extremely stressful period for us… the whole team worked very hard, but we did over‑expand our headcount.”

The move is also part of CEO Andy Jassy’s plan to streamline management layers and cut costs; Amazon has already cut about 30,000 corporate employees from the end of last year through January this year.

After the layoff announcement, a Slack channel with nearly 37,000 Amazon employees sparked heated discussion, with staff asking about severance calculations, internal job‑application permissions and whether another wave of layoffs is coming. Meanwhile, despite trimming the retail division, Amazon is reinvesting funds and talent into AI infrastructure and its AWS cloud business, even reaching out to previously laid‑off employees to invite them to apply for AI‑related positions, reflecting a broader tech‑industry shift in resource allocation.

items.title: 「美版Deepseek」交答卷 Reflection AI發表首款開放權重模型 提供美企新選擇
items.title_en: "American Deepseek" Answers the Call: Reflection AI Unveils First Open-Weight Model, Giving U.S. Companies a New Option
paras: 美國人工智慧新創公司 Reflection AI 於 10 月 5 日發表其首款開放權重模型「Beam」。該模型採用混合專家架構(MoE)，專為程式碼編寫、邏輯推理與 AI 代理人(agentic)等工作負載進行訓練。
Reflection AI 的成立宗旨，在於為不願或無法使用中國開源模型的企業與政府機構，提供具競爭力的美製開放模型選擇。
技術架構與推論效能 根據 Reflection AI 官方發布的資料，Beam 擁有約 5,010 億(501B)總參數，但在執行單一任務時僅啟用約 230 億(23B)參數。在標竿測試表現上，Beam 於 SWE-bench Verified 取得 80.9 分，在 Terminal-Bench v2.1 則取得 80.1 分。
官方聲稱，Beam 的效能可與中國智譜 AI 的 GLM-5.2 競爭，並接近阿里的 Qwen 3.8-Max，且推論所需的計算量僅為 GLM-5.2 或 GPT-6 Luna 等競品的 1/3 至 1/4。
在訓練細節方面，Beam 在預訓練階段使用了 23.8 兆 Token 的網路與授權資料。隨後的強化學習階段，則動用 10,500 張輝達(Nvidia)GB300 GPU 連續運作 4 週，產生超過 1 億次模擬演練(rollouts)。
該模型具備 100 萬 Token 的上下文窗口，預計於本月底在 Apache 2.0 許可證下公開模型權重與技術報告。不過，科技媒體 TechCrunch 指出，Reflection AI 官方所公布的效能數據目前尚未經過第三方獨立機構驗證。

團隊背景與資本算力佈局 Reflection AI 由前 Google DeepMind 研究人員 Misha Laskin 與 Ioannis Antonoglou 於 2024 年創立。公司目前估值約達 250 億美元，累計融資金額約 47 億美元，投資方包含輝達(投資 8 億美元)、紅杉資本(Sequoia Capital)與光速創投(Lightspeed Venture Partners)。

為確保模型訓練所需的龐大算力，Reflection AI 簽訂了總額超過 70 億美元的算力合約。其中包括與埃隆·馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下的 SpaceX 合作，取得其 Colossus 2 資料中心的 GB300 晶片使用權至 2029 年，並與雲端服務供應商 Nebius 簽署長期算力協議。此外，該公司亦參與美國能源部的 Genesis Mission 科研計畫，為美國國家實驗室提供開放模型。
市場策略與引述觀點 Reflection AI 將市場定位於大型企業、政府機關及「主權 AI」領域。今年 3 月，該公司與韓國新世界集團(Shinsegae Group)簽署合作備忘錄，規劃打造 250 兆瓦(MW)的主權 AI 工廠，美國商務部長 Howard Lutnick 亦出席了簽約儀式。
針對模型發展的進程，執行長 Misha Laskin 先前曾坦言，將模型能力提升至頂尖前沿需要時間累積，並表示：「這就像造火箭一樣，建造一枚大火箭是需要時間的。」
Laskin 同時透露，下一代能力更強大的模型訓練已經展開。而輝達執行長黃仁勳長期倡導「AI 工廠」概念，強調支持開放 AI 生態系有助於推動整體產業的硬體需求成長。
paras_en: On October 5, Reflection AI, a U.S. artificial‑intelligence startup, announced its first open‑weight model called Beam. The model uses a mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) architecture and is trained specifically for workloads such as code generation, logical reasoning, and agentic AI tasks.
Reflection AI was founded to give enterprises and government agencies that are unwilling or unable to use Chinese open‑source models a competitive, U.S.-made open model alternative.

According to data released by Reflection AI, Beam has roughly 501 billion total parameters, but only about 23 billion parameters are activated for any single task. In benchmark tests, Beam scored 80.9 on SWE‑bench Verified and 80.1 on Terminal‑Bench v2.1.

The company claims Beam’s performance can compete with China’s Zhipu AI GLM‑5.2 and is close to Alibaba’s Qwen 3.8‑Max, while its inference compute requirement is only one‑third to one‑quarter of that needed by GLM‑5.2 or GPT‑6 Luna and similar rivals.

In terms of training, Beam was pretrained on 23.8 trillion tokens of web and licensed data. The subsequent reinforcement‑learning phase used 10,500 Nvidia GB300 GPUs running continuously for four weeks, generating over 100 million rollout simulations.

The model supports a 1 million‑token context window and is slated to have its weights and technical report released under an Apache 2.0 license by the end of the month. However, tech outlet TechCrunch notes that the performance figures released by Reflection AI have not yet been independently verified by a third party.

Team and funding background: Reflection AI was founded in 2024 by former Google DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The company is now valued at about $25 billion and has raised roughly $4.7 billion, with investors including Nvidia ($800 million), Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

To secure the massive compute needed for training, Reflection AI signed compute contracts worth more than $7 billion. These include a deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX for access to its Colossus 2 data‑center GB300 chips through 2029, a long‑term agreement with cloud provider Nebius, and participation in the U.S. Department of Energy’s Genesis Mission program supplying open models to national labs.

Market strategy and remarks: Reflection AI targets large enterprises, government agencies, and the “sovereign AI” segment. In March, the company signed an MOU with South Korea’s Shinsegae Group to build a 250‑megawatt sovereign‑AI factory, an event attended by U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

Regarding the model’s development timeline, CEO Misha Laskin has previously said that pushing model capabilities to the cutting edge takes time, likening it to building a rocket: “Building a big rocket takes time.”

Laskin also disclosed that training of a next‑generation, more powerful model is already underway, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s long‑standing advocacy of the “AI factory” concept underscores that supporting an open‑AI ecosystem will drive overall hardware demand growth.

items.title: 美債殖利率攀升重創小型股！羅素2000瀕臨修正 資金轉向「科技七巨頭」避波動
items.title_en: Rising U.S. Treasury Yields Cripple Small‑Cap Stocks; Russell 2000 Nears Correction as Funds Shift to the “Big Seven Tech” for Stability
paras: 美國公債殖利率飆升，正在重創股市中一些容易被忽略的部分，以小型股為主的羅素2000指數正逐步逼近修正區域，反觀投資人對科技股重燃熱情，讓標普500指數今年來表現一舉超車。
原本市場預期，今年健康的經濟成長將推動股市漲勢擴大到更多類股，然而羅素2000指數如今距離不到兩個月前創下的歷史收盤高點已經回檔9%，以周三(7日)收盤的2793.20點來計算，正瀕臨步入修正領域。
市場通常把修正定義為從近期高點下跌至少10%，這意味著羅素2000指數若收在2761.58點或更低，將正式進入修正。
小型股指數今年來績效已落後標普500指數，這與幾周前的情況大相逕庭，主要原因是投資人重新湧入一小群人工智慧(AI)概念股，幫助大型股指數周二創新高。
FactSet數據顯示，羅素2000指數今年來上漲12.5%，標普500指數同期上漲14%。
Truist Advisory Services投資長Keith Lerner說：「近期小型股下跌背後的『第一個，也是最重要的因素』」是美國長債殖利率上升。較高的利率正帶來影響，只是科技業掩蓋了這一點。」
整體而言，過去一個月以來，大多數對利率敏感的類股都承受壓力。根據FactSet數據，自9月初以來，標普500指數當中的金融類股與房地產類股都下跌逾7%，材料類股下跌5.4%，工業類股下跌4%。
Lerner說：「對我而言，關鍵在於小型股對利率更加敏感，它們的負債較多，而且相較於大型股，浮動利率債務也更多。」
事實上，通膨疑慮、油價上漲以及美國財政赤字擴大所引發的債券殖利率上升，可能為小型股帶來估值與再融資壓力。規模較小且尚未獲利的企業，通常高度依賴充裕的浮動利率債務來支應成長。當利率大幅走高時，借貸成本可能侵蝕本來就很有限的利潤率。
面對利率節節攀升，包括「科技七巨頭」在內的大型股企業卻相對抗跌，儘管它們正為支應AI建設而大量新增債務。在波動劇烈的利率環境下，投資人正重新湧入這些公司，以及其他獲利表現亮眼的企業，尋求避風港。
近期標普500指數上漲，反映資金轉向資產負債表較強、品質較高的企業，但即使是專攻科技領域的小型股也表現不佳，根據FactSet數據，景順標普小型資訊科技類股ETF(Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF)(PSCT)自6月30日創下歷史高點以來，已下跌10.4%。
盈透證券(Interactive Brokers)首席策略師Steve Sosnick認為，儘管經濟仍保持健康，但目前的環境對小型股並不特別有利。他形容經濟「不錯」，但也擔心經濟已由AI資料中心建設主導。
他說：「第2季GDP成長2.2%，未必能讓所有船隻一起上升。因此，我們看到的是不均衡的經濟成長，隨著利率大幅回升，這對小型股而言是一個艱難的環境。」
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have surged, severely hurting often‑overlooked parts of the market, with the small‑cap‑heavy Russell 2000 index edging toward a correction zone, while investors’ renewed enthusiasm for tech stocks has helped the S&P 500 outpace them this year.

The market had originally expected that healthy economic growth this year would broaden the rally to more sectors, but the Russell 2000 is already down 9% from the historic closing high set less than two months ago, sitting at 2,793.20 points on Wednesday (the 7th) and teetering on the edge of a correction.
A correction is typically defined as a drop of at least 10% from a recent peak, meaning the Russell 2000 would officially enter correction territory if it closes at 2,761.58 points or lower.

Small‑cap performance has lagged the S&P 500 this year, a stark reversal from a few weeks ago, mainly because investors have poured back into a handful of AI‑related stocks, boosting large‑cap indices to a new high on Tuesday.
FactSet data show the Russell 2000 is up 12.5% year‑to‑date, while the S&P 500 has risen 14% over the same period.

Keith Lerner, chief investment officer at Truist Advisory Services, said the "first and most important factor" behind the recent small‑cap decline is the rise in long‑term U.S. Treasury yields, noting that higher rates are having an impact that the tech sector tends to mask.

Overall, over the past month most rate‑sensitive sectors have felt pressure. FactSet data indicate that since early September, financials and real estate within the S&P 500 have each fallen more than 7%, materials down 5.4% and industrials down 4%.
Lerner added, "For me, the key is that small caps are more rate‑sensitive—they carry more debt and, compared with large caps, have a higher proportion of floating‑rate liabilities."

In fact, inflation worries, rising oil prices and a widening U.S. fiscal deficit have pushed bond yields higher, creating valuation and refinancing pressure for small caps. Smaller, unprofitable firms often rely heavily on abundant floating‑rate debt to fund growth, and sharply higher rates can erode their already thin profit margins.

Facing climbing rates, large‑cap firms—including the so‑called “Big Seven Tech” companies—have been relatively resilient despite adding substantial debt to fund AI initiatives. In a volatile rate environment, investors are flowing back into these firms and other high‑quality, profitable companies as safe havens.

The recent S&P 500 rally reflects a shift toward companies with stronger balance sheets and higher quality, yet even tech‑focused small caps have struggled. FactSet shows the Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF (PSCT) has fallen 10.4% since its June 30 peak.

Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, believes that although the economy remains healthy, the current backdrop is not especially friendly to small caps. He describes the economy as "pretty good" but worries it is becoming dominated by AI data‑center construction.
He said, "Q2 GDP growth of 2.2% may not lift all boats. So we see uneven economic growth, and with rates climbing sharply, that creates a tough environment for small‑cap stocks."

items.title: 不到一年裁員3萬人 亞馬遜一邊瘦身 一邊豪賭AI
items.title_en: Amazon Cuts 30,000 Jobs in Less Than a Year While Betting Big on AI
paras: 多名亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 員工周二（6日）透露，公司多個業務部門當天啟動新一輪裁員，據《Business Insider》周四報導，有員工在亞馬遜一個擁有近3.7萬名成員的Slack頻道中發文，稱自己收到了崗位被撤銷的郵件通知。
該頻道隨即被大量提問淹沒，員工關心的焦點集中在遣散補償方案、內部崗位投遞權限，以及本輪裁員是否會繼續擴大等方面。
消息人士透露，本輪裁員覆蓋客服、平台支持、亞馬遜零售業務的工程崗位等多個單元，印度和英國的團隊也在波及之列。
一位熟悉情況的人士說，受影響員工總數不到1,000人。亞馬遜發言人隨後向《Business Insider》證實，公司周二裁撤了少量職位，主要集中在門市業務部門。
此次裁員是亞馬遜自2025年10月以來多輪人員調整的延續。
2025年10月28日，亞馬遜人力資源高級副總裁貝絲·加萊蒂（Beth Galetti）發布全員備忘錄，宣布裁撤約1.4萬個企業崗位，約佔企業員工總數4%，涉及AWS雲端服務、設備與服務、廣告、Prime Video、HR等多個核心部門。
當時亞馬遜全球員工約156萬人，其中企業和技術崗位約35萬人。亞馬遜表示，即使在其他領域裁員，也將繼續在戰略領域招聘。
僅僅三個月後，2026年1月28日，亞馬遜又宣布裁減1.6萬名企業級員工，波及範圍擴展至AWS的Bedrock、AI雲端服務、Redshift、數據倉庫平台以及ProServe咨詢部門，地區上覆蓋美國、英國和印度。
有員工反映，裁員通知郵件送達後，其辦公門禁權限被即時停用，需由安保人員陪同離開亞馬遜辦公室。
據第三方追蹤平台Layoffs.fyi統計，今年1月至9月，亞馬遜已裁減約1.7萬人。算上2025年10月的1.4萬人，過去不到一年時間內，亞馬遜累計裁員人數已經超過3萬人。其中超過七成集中於L5-L7職級中層管理崗位，被裁對象以白領和技術人員為主。
不過，外界注意到一個耐人尋味的反差，亞馬遜一邊大規模裁人，一邊將資本開支推向歷史新高。
亞馬遜2026年資本支出預計約2,000億美元，絕大部分投向AI基礎設施（資料中心、自研晶片和網路設備），較2025年激增近60%‌。
執行長安迪·賈西在4月致股東信中確認了這一計畫，並強調這是為了抓住千載難逢的機會，而非一時興起。‌‌這相當於裁減白領省下的成本，被大規模轉入算力投資。
paras_en: Several Amazon (AMZN-US) employees disclosed on Tuesday (June 6) that the company launched a new round of layoffs across multiple business units. According to Business Insider on Thursday, an employee posted in a Slack channel with nearly 37,000 members that they had received an email notification that their position had been eliminated.
The channel was quickly flooded with questions, with employees focusing on severance packages, internal job application access, and whether this round of layoffs would expand further.
Sources say the layoffs cover customer service, platform support, engineering roles in Amazon Retail, and also affect teams in India and the UK.

An insider said the total number of affected employees is less than 1,000. An Amazon spokesperson later confirmed to Business Insider that the Tuesday cuts involved a small number of positions, mainly in the retail operations division.
This round continues Amazon’s series of workforce adjustments since October 2025.

On October 28, 2025, Amazon HR senior vice president Beth Galetti sent a company-wide memo announcing the elimination of about 14,000 corporate positions, roughly 4% of corporate staff, affecting core units such as AWS, Devices & Services, Advertising, Prime Video, and HR.

At that time Amazon had about 1.56 million global employees, with about 350,000 in corporate and technical roles. Amazon said it would continue hiring in strategic areas even as it cut jobs elsewhere.

Three months later, on January 28, 2026, Amazon announced another cut of 16,000 corporate employees, expanding the scope to AWS Bedrock, AI cloud services, Redshift, data warehouse platforms, and ProServe consulting, covering the U.S., U.K., and India.
Some employees reported that after receiving the layoff notice, their office access was immediately revoked and they had to leave the Amazon office with security escort.

According to third‑party tracker Layoffs.fyi, Amazon has cut about 17,000 people from January to September 2026. Adding the 14,000 from October 2025, Amazon has laid off more than 30,000 people in less than a year, with over 70% of the cuts concentrated in L5‑L7 mid‑management roles, primarily white‑collar and technical staff.
However, observers note a striking contrast: Amazon is cutting jobs on a massive scale while driving capital expenditures to record highs.

Amazon’s 2026 capital spend is projected at about $200 billion, with the vast majority directed toward AI infrastructure—data centers, in‑house chips, and networking equipment—an increase of nearly 60% from 2025.

In a shareholder letter in April, CEO Andy Jassy confirmed this plan and emphasized that it is about seizing a once‑in‑a‑lifetime opportunity, not a fleeting impulse. This effectively reallocates the savings from white‑collar cuts into large‑scale compute investment.

items.title: 華爾街對Marvell超樂觀 亮眼財測點燃成長潛力
items.title_en: Wall Street Overly Optimistic on Marvell; Bright Financial Forecast Ignites Growth Potential
paras: 《巴隆周刊》周三(7日)報導，邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)獲得華爾街大量讚賞，但對於一家預期未來5年營收每年將成長55%至60%的公司而言，這樣的看好或許並不令人意外。
根據FactSet數據，截至本周已有至少18名分析師上調Marvell的目標價。這是在這家晶片與網路設備公司於紐約舉行的投資人日公布積極成長目標後出現的反應。
StoneX分析師Cody Acree便是其中一位看多者，他周二晚間將Marvell目標價從275美元上調至375美元。Acree在研究報告中寫道，這次投資人日「重新定義了Marvell AI商機的規模與持續時間」。
Acree給予Marvell股票「買進」評級。他的新目標價意味著，與周二收盤價相比，仍有31%的上漲空間。
Oppenheimer分析師Rick Schafer周三也表示，「市場氣氛明確的偏樂觀，表現超出預期，因為管理層大幅上調了財務目標。」他並將Marvell目標價從325美元上調至425美元，同時給予Marvell股票「優於大盤」評級。
推動華爾街分析師紛紛上調目標價的主要催化劑，是Marvell亮眼的財測。該公司預估，2031會計年度調整後每股盈餘(EPS)將超過30美元，營收則達到700億至900億美元。作為對照，2026會計年度Marvell每股盈餘為2.84美元，營收為82億美元。
Marvell股價周三下跌1.5%，收在282.73美元，此前周二才大漲5.8%。周二股價在執行長Matt Murphy公布營收目標後立即走高。
今年以來，Marvell股價已上漲238%。隨著AI熱潮推升晶片與網路產品需求，Marvell股價持續受到市場追捧。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Wednesday (the 7th) that Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) has received abundant praise from Wall Street, but for a company that expects revenue to grow 55% to 60% annually over the next five years, such optimism may not be surprising.

According to FactSet data, at least 18 analysts have raised Marvell’s price target as of this week. This reaction came after the chip and networking equipment company announced aggressive growth goals at its investor day in New York.

StoneX analyst Cody Acree is one of the bullish voices; on Tuesday night he lifted Marvell’s price target from $275 to $375. In his research note, Acree wrote that the investor day "redefined the scale and duration of Marvell’s AI opportunity."
Acree gave Marvell a "Buy" rating. His new target implies a 31% upside from Tuesday’s closing price.

Oppenheimer analyst Rick Schafer also said on Wednesday that "the market sentiment is clearly optimistic, outperforming expectations, because management significantly raised its financial targets." He raised Marvell’s target from $325 to $425 and assigned an "Outperform" rating.

The main catalyst driving analysts to raise targets is Marvell’s impressive financial outlook. The company forecasts adjusted FY 2031 earnings per share (EPS) of over $30 and revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion. By comparison, FY 2026 EPS is $2.84 and revenue $8.2 billion.
Marvell’s stock fell 1.5% on Wednesday, closing at $282.73, after having jumped 5.8% on Tuesday. The Tuesday rally came immediately after CEO Matt Murphy announced the revenue targets.
Since the start of the year, Marvell’s share price has risen 238%. Fueled by the AI boom driving demand for chips and networking products, the stock continues to attract strong market interest.

items.title: 德國大幅上調2026及2027年經濟成長預估
items.title_en: Germany Significantly Raises 2026 and 2027 Economic Growth Forecasts
paras: 德國政府周四(8日)發布最新秋季經濟預測報告，大幅上調今明兩年的經濟成長預期。受惠於強勁出口、製造業展現韌性以及政府擴大支出，德國將2026年GDP成長率預估值由原先的0.5%調升逾一倍至1.3%，2027年預測值由0.9%上調至1.1%。
德國經濟部指出，儘管受中東衝突影響價格攀升以及美國關稅帶來不確定性，德國第二季經濟仍成長0.3%。
本次經濟回升主要由政府以舉債融資推動的基礎建設投資、強化國防武力，以及企業增加德國製造能源密集型產品庫存所帶動。官方預估2026年出口將成長3.7%，但2028年受地緣政治動盪影響，經濟成長率恐放緩至0.6%。
針對經濟前景，德國經濟部長Katherina Reiche表示：「德國經濟正在成長，這是一個重要訊號，但這只是個開始。」
她強調，現在關鍵在於將初期的復甦轉化為真正的經濟動能，並指出：「這種成長必須具備自我維持的能力，這正是我們必須持續推進改革的原因。」
此外，通膨壓力仍不容忽視，官方預計2026年與2027年通膨率將分別達2.7%與3.0%。
為減輕民眾負擔，總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的政府決定自10月起至12月底，將汽油與柴油每公升減稅0.17歐元。經濟部提醒，未來經濟走勢將高度取決於中東及烏克蘭地緣政治衝突的後續演變。
paras_en: Germany's government on Thursday (the 8th) released its latest autumn economic forecast, sharply raising growth expectations for this year and next. Benefiting from strong exports, resilient manufacturing and expanded government spending, Germany lifted its 2026 GDP growth estimate from the original 0.5% to 1.3%—more than double—and raised the 2027 forecast from 0.9% to 1.1%.
The German Ministry of Economy noted that despite price rises caused by the Middle East conflict and uncertainty from U.S. tariffs, Germany's economy still grew 0.3% in the second quarter.

The rebound is mainly driven by government‑financed infrastructure investment, strengthened defence capabilities, and firms increasing inventories of energy‑intensive manufactured products. Officials project 2026 exports to grow 3.7%, but in 2028, geopolitical turbulence could slow the growth rate to 0.6%.
On the economic outlook, Economy Minister Katherina Reiche said: “The German economy is growing, which is an important signal, but it is only the beginning.”
She emphasized that the key now is to turn the early recovery into genuine economic momentum, adding: “This growth must be self‑sustaining, which is why we must continue to push reforms.”
In addition, inflation pressures remain a concern; officials expect inflation rates of 2.7% in 2026 and 3.0% in 2027.

To ease the burden on households, the government led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz decided to cut the tax on gasoline and diesel by €0.17 per litre from October through the end of December. The ministry warned that future economic trends will heavily depend on how the Middle East and Ukraine geopolitical conflicts evolve.

items.title: ChatGPT還沒問世就出手！老虎環球押對OpenAI 帳面獲利上看50億美元
items.title_en: Tiger Global Bet on OpenAI Before ChatGPT Launched, Eyeing $5 B Paper Profit
paras: 在ChatGPT問世前一年，老虎環球(Tiger Global)便押注OpenAI，如今這筆早期投資有望帶來50億美元帳面獲利，成為該公司成立25年來最成功的投資之一，也為這家曾遭科技股重挫打擊的投資機構扳回一城。
據《彭博》周四(8日)報導，OpenAI正洽談以1.4兆美元估值募資300億美元。知情人士透露，若以此估值計算，老虎環球持股的潛在獲利可達50億美元，但仍屬尚未實現的帳面收益。

ChatGPT問世前搶先布局 早期押注推升基金表現

2021年，OpenAI共同創辦人暨執行長阿特曼致電老虎環球創辦人柯爾曼(Chase Coleman)，邀請他以157億美元估值，成為少數投資OpenAI的機構投資人之一。當時距離ChatGPT公開推出還有一年，多數大型投資人尚未察覺其潛力。
老虎環球當年同意投入1.5億美元，之後多次加碼，並成為首家投資OpenAI的避險基金。隨著ChatGPT於2022年爆紅並掀起AI軍備競賽，這筆提前布局的投資開始展現成果。
知情人士指出，OpenAI投資已帶動老虎環球旗下避險基金，以及同時投資上市與未上市公司的基金，今年前九個月分別上漲9.4%與19.3%。
OpenAI也是老虎環球最新一期創投基金的最大持股之一。截至6月30日，該基金未扣費用的內部報酬率(IRR)達65%，扣除費用後為44%。這些數字反映整體基金表現，並非單筆OpenAI投資報酬率。
不過，老虎環球仍須等到OpenAI首次公開發行(IPO)，才能完全出脫持股、實現收益，而阿特曼已將上市時程延至至少明年。老虎環球與OpenAI均不予置評。

科技股重挫後調整策略 聚焦規模較小的集中投資

這筆投資對老虎環球具有重振旗鼓的意義。2022年，利率攀升重創新創企業，科技股大跌與創投資產估值下修，使其管理資產由1,000億美元驟降至500億美元。
旗下多檔基金虧損引發高層改組，也促使公司回歸規模較小、持股更集中的投資策略，由柯爾曼加強掌管流動性較低的投資。目前公司管理資產約600億美元。
柯爾曼也更直接參與最新創投基金Private Investment Partners 16的管理。該基金規模27億美元，為約十年來最小，除OpenAI外，也投資Anthropic、自駕車公司Waymo與AI新創Temporal Technologies。
OpenAI如今可望躋身老虎環球歷來最成功的投資之列。該公司2010年投資京東(JD-US)(09618-HK)，曾獲利逾65億美元；2009年押注Flipkart，則帶來35億美元收益。相較之下，OpenAI的50億美元潛在獲利雖相當可觀，最終成果仍待實際退出時驗證。
paras_en: A year before ChatGPT debuted, Tiger Global placed a bet on OpenAI, and the early stake now looks set to generate a $5 billion paper gain – one of the firm’s most successful investments in its 25‑year history and a comeback for the firm that was hit hard by a tech‑stock rout.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday (the 8th), OpenAI is in talks to raise $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Sources said that at that valuation Tiger Global’s holding could be worth about $5 billion in potential profit, though the gain remains unrealised on paper.

Tiger Global’s early positioning before ChatGPT’s launch boosted fund performance. In 2021, OpenAI co‑founder and CEO Sam Altman called Tiger Global founder Chase Coleman and invited him to invest at a $15.7 billion valuation, making Tiger one of the few institutional investors in OpenAI. At the time, ChatGPT was still a year away from public release and most large investors had not yet recognised its potential.

Tiger Global agreed to put in $150 million that year and later added to the stake, becoming the first hedge fund to back OpenAI. As ChatGPT went viral in 2022 and sparked an AI arms race, the pre‑emptive investment began to pay off.

Sources said OpenAI’s investment has lifted Tiger Global’s hedge‑fund arm as well as its funds that invest in both listed and private companies, which rose 9.4% and 19.3% respectively in the first nine months of this year.

OpenAI is also one of the largest holdings in Tiger Global’s latest venture fund. As of June 30, the fund’s internal rate of return (IRR) was 65% before fees and 44% after fees – figures that reflect overall fund performance, not the return on the single OpenAI stake.

However, Tiger Global must wait for OpenAI’s initial public offering to fully exit the position and realise the gains, and Altman has pushed the IPO timeline out to at least next year. Neither Tiger Global nor OpenAI commented on the matter.

The investment is a morale boost for Tiger Global after a strategic shift following a tech‑stock slump. In 2022, rising rates battered startups, tech stocks plunged and venture‑capital valuations were cut, shrinking assets under management from $100 billion to $50 billion.

Losses across several funds triggered a senior‑leadership reshuffle and prompted the firm to revert to a smaller‑scale, more concentrated‑holding strategy, with Coleman taking tighter control of less‑liquid investments. The firm now manages about $60 billion in assets.

Coleman is also more directly involved in managing the latest venture fund, Private Investment Partners 16, which is $2.7 billion in size – the smallest in roughly a decade – and besides OpenAI also backs Anthropic, self‑driving car firm Waymo and AI startup Temporal Technologies.

OpenAI now ranks among Tiger Global’s most successful investments ever. The firm’s 2010 investment in JD.com (JD‑US) generated over $6.5 billion, and its 2009 bet on Flipkart yielded $3.5 billion. By comparison, the potential $5 billion gain from OpenAI is sizable, but the ultimate outcome will only be confirmed when the stake is actually sold.

items.title: 白宮說法總是反覆無常 川普言論對油價影響力快速減退
items.title_en: White House Statements Remain Inconsistent; Trump's Remarks Quickly Lose Influence on Oil Prices
paras: 長達數月的伊朗衝突帶來持續的「頭條疲勞」，原油交易員正逐漸無視美國總統川普的強硬言論，油價對白宮政治宣示的敏感度大幅降低。
據《彭博》統計，這項轉變在市場對比中十分鮮明：4月1日川普揚言將伊朗炸回「石器時代」時，布蘭特原油價格隨即暴漲逾 7%，每桶突破 109 美元；然而到了 10 月 1 日川普警告伊朗若不簽停火協議將「不復存在」時，原油價格卻幾乎毫無波動。
由於白宮戰爭策略與外交宣示反覆無常，交易員已普遍縮減下注規模以規避風險。
Again Capital 合夥人 John Kilduff 表示：「這幾個月來全是頭條新聞狂潮，到了這個階段，你真的像在玩地緣政治輪盤，每個人的交易規模都變小了。」
觀望氣氛導致布蘭特原油期貨合約未平倉總量暴跌至 2025 年 3 月以來新低，日內波動幅度和價差顯著收窄。Tortoise Capital Advisors LLC 高級投資組合經理 Rob Thummel 指出：「交易員對白宮反覆無常的言論感到麻痺癱瘓。」
對於局勢演變，金融機構坦言難以預測。摩根大通分析師在報告中坦言：「我們根本不知道該如何建立終局模型，雖然剛開始我們以為可以。」
JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC 首席市場策略師 Michael O’Rourke 表示，川普總統說了很多話且立場頻繁轉變，幾輪頭條洗禮後市場確實不再敏感。大家顯然更關注實體貨流數據，因為那才是即時且具操作價值的。這顯示市場已將注意力從政治口水轉向實體油輪與供應流量。
paras_en: Months of the Iran conflict have caused persistent headline fatigue, and crude traders are increasingly ignoring President Trump’s hard‑line rhetoric, with oil prices becoming far less sensitive to White House political pronouncements.

Bloomberg data highlights the shift starkly: on April 1, when Trump threatened to blast Iran back to the “Stone Age,” Brent crude surged more than 7% to over $109 a barrel; but by October 1, when Trump warned Iran it would “no longer exist” without a cease‑fire deal, oil prices barely moved at all.
Because the White House’s war strategy and diplomatic statements are so erratic, traders have broadly reduced position sizes to hedge risk.

John Kilduff, a partner at Again Capital, said: “These past few months have been a frenzy of headline news; at this point it feels like playing a geopolitical roulette, and everyone’s trade sizes have shrunk.”

The wait‑and‑see mood has driven Brent futures open interest down to its lowest level since March 2025, with intraday volatility and spreads tightening sharply. Rob Thummel, senior portfolio manager at Tortoise Capital Advisors LLC, noted: “Traders are numb and paralyzed by the White House’s flip‑flopping statements.”

Financial institutions admit they can’t predict how the situation will evolve. A JPMorgan analyst wrote in a note: “We have no idea how to build an end‑state model, even though we initially thought we could.”

Michael O’Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC, said that after many headlines and frequent shifts in Trump’s stance, the market is no longer sensitive. “Everyone is clearly focusing on physical flow data, because that’s real‑time and actionable,” he added, noting that attention has moved from political rhetoric to actual oil tankers and supply flows.

items.title: 戰火延燒科技基礎設施！「俄版Google」Yandex遭無人機攻擊 大型資料中心全面停擺
items.title_en: War Extends to Tech Infrastructure! Russia’s “Google” Yandex Hit by Drone Attack, Major Data Center Shut Down
paras: 俄羅斯網路巨頭Yandex周四(8日)表示，旗下一家主要資料中心遭無人機攻擊後，已經暫停營運。
CNBC報導，根據Yandex的聲明，這座位於俄羅斯西部梁贊州薩索沃(Sasovo, Ryazan)的資料中心遭到攻擊並引發火災，部分基礎設施受到影響。聲明中說，由於該座資料中心目前已全面停止運作，部分Yandex服務可能因此無法供用戶使用。
Yandex說：「沒有人員傷亡，緊急服務人員已在現場處理後續情況。」
總部位於莫斯科的Yandex被稱為「俄羅斯版Google」，其搜尋引擎服務在俄羅斯獲得廣泛使用，旗下還開發出在當地最先進的生成式人工智慧(AI)模型「YandexGPT」。
雖然烏克蘭並未宣稱對Yandex遭襲事件負責，但隨著烏克蘭持續擴大攻擊對俄羅斯的基礎設施，俄國境內這類設施受到的威脅正與日俱增。
近期遭烏克蘭鎖定的攻擊目標包括俄羅斯煉油廠，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)曾表示，這些煉油廠被用來「為戰爭以及殺害烏克蘭人提供資金」。
此外，烏克蘭也加強攻擊俄羅斯零售巨頭Wildberries，該公司是俄羅斯消費基礎設施的重要一環。
澤倫斯基上周表示，烏克蘭將進一步加強對俄羅斯煉油廠的攻勢，以回應俄國當局近期為了迫使基輔等城市居民離開所展開的新一輪空襲政策。
paras_en: Yandex, Russia’s internet giant, said on Thursday (the 8th) that a major data center under its umbrella has suspended operations after being attacked by a drone.

According to Yandex’s statement cited by CNBC, the data center in Sasovo, Ryazan region in western Russia was attacked, causing a fire and affecting some infrastructure. The statement said that because the data center is now fully shut down, some Yandex services may be unavailable to users.
Yandex said: “No personnel were injured, and emergency services are on site handling the aftermath.”
Headquartered in Moscow, Yandex is dubbed the “Russian Google,” with its search engine widely used in Russia and it also developed the country’s most advanced generative AI model, YandexGPT.
Although Ukraine has not claimed responsibility for the Yandex incident, the threat to such facilities inside Russia is growing as Ukraine continues to expand attacks on Russian infrastructure.
Recent Ukrainian‑targeted attacks have included Russian oil refineries, which President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said are used to “fund the war and the killing of Ukrainians.”
In addition, Ukraine has stepped up attacks on Russian retail giant Wildberries, a key component of Russia’s consumer infrastructure.

Zelenskyy said last week that Ukraine will further intensify its offensive against Russian oil refineries in response to a new wave of Russian air‑strike policies aimed at forcing residents of cities such as Kyiv to evacuate.

items.title: 有輝達撐腰也不買單？澳洲資料中心商Firmus巨額IPO生變
items.title_en: Nvidia Backing Not Enough? Australian Data Center Firm Firmus Faces IPO Turmoil
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)投資的澳洲資料中心業者Firmus Grid，原擬透過首次公開發行(IPO)募資55億美元，如今卻因認購需求驟降，上市前景蒙上陰影。這宗原可躋身澳洲歷來最大IPO之列的交易，凸顯借貸成本攀升之際，投資人對AI基礎建設的高估值與龐大資金需求日益謹慎。
據《彭博》報導，Firmus每股11澳元的推介價格未獲足夠支持，與公司幾天前宣稱認購意向遠超發行規模、估值上看300億美元形成反差。公司周四(8日)結束簿記建檔後，仍未明確公布定價或交易架構，引發市場揣測可能降價，甚至取消IPO。Firmus未回應置評要求。

估值兩個月拚近三倍 擴建藍圖仍待兌現

Firmus今年8月初完成一輪包含Jane Street與黑石(BX-US)參與的募資，估值為105億美元，意味此次IPO試圖在短短兩個月內，將估值推升至接近三倍。
然而，公司2026會計年度營收僅5,100萬美元，目前營運兩座資料中心。投資人文件顯示，其規劃的912百萬瓦(MW)容量中，僅46MW已建成，其餘仍仰賴後續開發。
Firmus計畫使用輝達硬體打造「AI工廠」，在亞洲擴建網路，服務Meta(META-US)與OpenAI等客戶，IPO資金正是支應工程的重要來源。因此，估值能否成立，高度取決於尚未完成的建設能否順利落地。
澳洲大型退休基金UniSuper選擇不參與認購，投資長皮爾斯(John Pearce)直言，公司故事吸引人，估值卻不具吸引力，必須有太多事情順利發展才能合理化價格。他也擔憂，Firmus未來仍須持續舉債與發股籌資。
此外，上市首日約58%股份即可自由交易，潛在賣壓、營運實績不足，以及監管趨嚴，也讓投資人卻步。

融資成本升高 上市疑慮波及合作夥伴

市場疑慮已擴散至持有Firmus股權、並承接至少8.55億澳元相關電力基礎設施合約的Maas Group(MGH-AU)。該股周四在雪梨盤中一度重挫30%，創歷來最大跌幅，隨後跌幅收斂至22%。
這場募資考驗也反映整體產業困境。部分AI雲端業者開始依賴高風險債務籌資，例如摩根大通(JPM-US)正為Volta Infrastructure推介50億美元槓桿貸款，殖利率約11%，用於挪威資料中心建設。
貝恩估計，AI產業到2031年須創造每年6兆美元營收，才能支撐目前投入資料中心的資本規模。
Arkevium Capital投資長Visseau指出，投資人仍相信AI，但不願以任何價格，買進大舉燒錢、仰賴少數客戶，且獲利仍在多年之後的公司。隨Anthropic最快下月也計畫大型IPO，Firmus的遭遇正為後續AI募資案敲響警鐘。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) has invested in Australian data centre operator Firmus Grid, which originally planned to raise $5.5 billion via an IPO, but a sharp drop in subscription demand now casts a shadow over its listing prospects. The deal, which could have been one of Australia’s largest IPOs, highlights investors’ growing caution about the high valuations and massive capital needs of AI infrastructure amid rising borrowing costs.

According to Bloomberg, Firmus’s suggested price of A$11 per share failed to attract sufficient support, contrasting with the company’s claim just days earlier that subscription interest far exceeded the offering size and implied a $30 billion valuation. After closing its book‑building on Thursday (the 8th), the firm still has not disclosed a final price or transaction structure, prompting market speculation of a price cut or even a cancellation. Firmus declined to comment.

Valuation Nearly Triples in Two Months, Expansion Blueprint Still Unfulfilled

In early August, Firmus completed a funding round that included Jane Street and BlackRock (BX-US), valuing the company at $10.5 billion, meaning the IPO aims to lift the valuation to almost three times that within just two months.

However, the company’s FY 2026 revenue is only $51 million, and it currently operates two data centres. Investor documents show that of the planned 912 MW capacity, only 46 MW is built, with the remainder dependent on future development.

Firmus plans to use Nvidia hardware to build an “AI factory,” expand its network across Asia and serve customers such as Meta (META-US) and OpenAI. IPO proceeds are intended to fund this engineering effort, so the credibility of the valuation hinges heavily on whether the unfinished construction can be completed successfully.

Australian superannuation giant UniSuper chose not to subscribe. Investment head John Pearce said the company’s story is compelling but the valuation is unattractive and would require too many things to go right to be justified. He also warned that Firmus will likely need to keep borrowing and issuing equity in the future.

In addition, about 58% of the shares would be freely tradable on the first day, raising concerns about potential selling pressure, insufficient operating track record, and tighter regulation, all of which deter investors.

Rising financing costs and listing doubts are spilling over to partners. The market’s concerns have extended to Maas Group (MGH-AU), which holds Firmus equity and has taken on at least A$855 million of related power‑infrastructure contracts. Its stock plunged as much as 30% on the Sydney exchange on Thursday before narrowing to a 22% loss.

The fundraising challenge also reflects broader industry strain. Some AI cloud providers are turning to high‑risk debt, such as JPMorgan (JPM-US) which is arranging a $5 billion leveraged loan for Volta Infrastructure at roughly an 11% yield to fund a Norwegian data centre project.
Bain estimates that the AI industry must generate $6 trillion of annual revenue by 2031 to sustain the current scale of data‑centre capital investment.

Arkevium Capital’s investment head Visseau said investors still believe in AI but are unwilling to pay any price for companies that burn cash, rely on a handful of customers and won’t be profitable for years. With Anthropic planning a large IPO as soon as next month, Firmus’s fate sounds a warning bell for future AI fundraising deals.

items.title: 債務壓力與能源衝擊夾擊 歐股挫至近4個月新低
items.title_en: Debt Pressure and Energy Shock Collide, European Stocks Slip to Near Four‑Month Low
paras: 受到美國企業大規模發債、中東能源危機加劇以及美國聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)釋放鷹派訊號的多重打擊，歐洲股市重挫至近4個月以來新低。
泛歐斯托克600指數(Stoxx Europe 600)周四(8日)早盤下跌0.9%；各國主要指數全線走低，其中德國DAX指數下跌0.9%，法國CAC 40指數下挫1.1%，英國富時100指數下跌0.6%，而義大利富時MIB指數跌幅最大，達1.6%。
市場不安主要源於美國科技巨頭(如SpaceX與博通)計畫發行高達800億美元的巨額公司債，擠壓主權債券資金並推升信用利差。雖然歐洲股市對純AI科技巨頭的直接曝險較低，但作為供應鏈夥伴的歐洲半導體股仍受波及，英飛凌(Infineon)下跌2.7%，ASML下跌2.3%。
對此，Bull Market Blueprint創辦人兼首席市場策略師Luke Davis指出：「歐洲雖擁有如ASML等重要受益企業，但這一成長題材在整體廣泛市場中所占的比重相對較小。」
同時，波斯灣與紅海的航運及能源基礎設施遭受無人機與飛彈襲擊，推升原油與天然氣期貨價格，加劇歐洲冬季能源成本負擔與停滯性通膨風險。此外，聯準會9月會議紀錄顯示多數官員仍預估年底前可能再度升息，消弭了市場對快速轉向貨幣寬鬆的期待。
法國財政危機也成為市場焦點，法國CAC 40指數跌至3月以來低點。法國央行總裁Emmanuel Moulin承認，國家財政與經濟狀況「十分嚴峻」，主要是預算赤字擴大與政治不確定性所致；但他明確排除了央行干預的可能性，強調巴黎當局無需歐洲央行(ECB)協助，必須透過國內預算改革來解決結構性赤字。
paras_en: The European equity market suffered a sharp decline to its lowest level in almost four months, hit by a combination of massive U.S. corporate bond issuance, an escalating Middle‑East energy crisis, and hawkish signals from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).

The Stoxx Europe 600 index fell 0.9% in early trade on Thursday (the 8th), and all major national indices were down: Germany’s DAX slipped 0.9%, France’s CAC 40 dropped 1.1%, the UK FTSE 100 fell 0.6%, while Italy’s FTSE MIB posted the biggest decline at 1.6%.

Market anxiety stems mainly from U.S. tech giants such as SpaceX and Broadcom planning to issue up to $80 billion of corporate bonds, crowding out sovereign‑bond funding and widening credit spreads. Although European stocks have relatively low direct exposure to pure AI tech leaders, European semiconductor firms that are part of the supply chain were still hit, with Infineon down 2.7% and ASML down 2.3%.

In response, Luke Davis, founder and chief market strategist at Bull Market Blueprint, said: “Europe does have important beneficiaries like ASML, but this growth theme represents a relatively small share of the broader market.”

At the same time, shipping and energy infrastructure in the Persian Gulf and Red Sea were struck by drones and missiles, pushing up crude oil and natural‑gas futures and worsening Europe’s winter energy‑cost burden and the risk of stagnant inflation. Moreover, the Fed’s September meeting minutes showed most officials still expect another rate hike before year‑end, dampening hopes for a rapid shift to monetary easing.

France’s fiscal crisis also grabbed market attention, with the CAC 40 sliding to its lowest level since March. French central bank governor Emmanuel Moulin admitted the country’s fiscal and economic situation is “very severe,” citing a widening budget deficit and political uncertainty, but he ruled out any central‑bank intervention, stressing that Paris does not need European Central Bank help and must address the structural deficit through domestic budget reforms.

items.title: 聯準會理事華勒：仍需升息 但可以有靈活性
items.title_en: Fed Governor Waller: More Rate Hikes Needed but Flexibility Is Possible
paras: 美國聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(8日)指出，若後續經濟數據符合預期，聯準會未來仍可能需要進一步升息，以確保通膨率順利回落至 2% 的政策目標。
不過華勒強調，升息步調具備「靈活性」，不一定需要在連續的會議上推動，只要在合理的時間內完成即可，這為 10 月會議暫停升息保留了空間。
華勒的最新表態呼應了近期多位官員的立場，市場預期聯準會將在 10 月 27 日至 28 日的會議上，將政策利率維持在 3.75% 至 4% 的區間不變。
聯準會在 9 月已升息 1 碼(0.25 個百分點)，且多數官員預估年底前還會再升息 1 碼。目前投資人普遍認為，聯準會將在國會期中選舉前一周的 10 月會議按兵不動，並於 12 月 8 日至 9 日的決策會議上再度升息。
對於支持繼續調升利率的理由，華勒分析，今年下半年經濟活動強勁，加上伊朗戰爭帶來的能源價格衝擊未解，以及人工智慧(AI)擴展增加對關鍵商品與服務的需求，皆推升了通膨壓力。他並不擔心貨幣緊縮會引發嚴重的經濟衰退，但擔心近期通膨加速會導致消費者、投資人與企業上調對未來的通膨預期。
此外，在聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)傾向減少政策指引的情況下，華勒則強調適度溝通的重要性。他認為，官員向市場傳達可能的利率走向，有助於錨定短期利率路徑，並能根據新公布的數據靈活調整升息節奏，可避免市場因缺乏訊號而產生劇烈波動。
paras_en: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday (the 8th) that if upcoming economic data come in line with expectations, the Fed may still need to raise rates further to ensure inflation falls back to the 2% policy target.

However, Waller stressed that the pace of rate hikes can be "flexible" and does not have to occur at consecutive meetings; it only needs to be completed within a reasonable time frame, leaving room to pause hikes at the October meeting.
Waller’s latest remarks echo the stance of several other officials recently, and the market expects the Fed to keep the policy rate unchanged in the Oct. 27‑28 meeting, staying in the 3.75%‑4% range.

The Fed already raised rates by one quarter‑point in September, and most officials project another 0.25‑point hike before year‑end. Investors generally think the Fed will hold steady at the October meeting, a week before the mid‑term elections, and then raise rates again at the Dec. 8‑9 decision meeting.

Regarding the case for further tightening, Waller noted that strong economic activity in the second half of the year, the unresolved energy‑price shock from the Iran war, and AI‑driven demand for key goods and services are all pushing inflation pressures higher. He is not worried that monetary tightening will trigger a severe recession, but he is concerned that accelerating inflation could cause consumers, investors and firms to raise their inflation expectations for the future.

Moreover, with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh leaning toward less policy guidance, Waller emphasized the importance of moderate communication. He believes that officials signaling possible rate paths helps anchor short‑term rate expectations and allows the pace of hikes to be adjusted flexibly as new data arrive, avoiding sharp market volatility from a lack of signals.

items.title: AI資料中心能救水泥業？CEMEX出貨暴增185%，但全美需求僅估增2%，恐難扭轉產業供需
items.title_en: Can AI Data Centers Rescue the Cement Industry? CEMEX Shipments Surge 185%, Yet U.S. Demand Expected to Grow Only 2%, Making It Hard to Shift Industry Supply‑Demand Balance
paras: 2026年10月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 人工智慧(AI)資料中心投資熱潮，受惠產業正從半導體、伺服器延伸至水泥、混凝土等傳統建材市場。過去市場關注科技巨頭投入多少資本支出，如今更值得注意的是，這些投資已開始轉化為實際工程訂單。美國水泥大廠CEMEX、Amrize及GCC陸續在法說會確認資料中心帶動出貨需求，顯示AI基礎設施建設已開始為建材業創造營收。

根據產業預測，全球超大型資料中心建築面積將從2024年的4,061萬平方英尺，擴大至2030年的7,200萬平方英尺，六年間增加3,139萬平方英尺，增幅達77.3%，年複合成長率約10.02%。隨著資料中心建築規模擴大，地基、樓板及相關土建工程所需的水泥、混凝土與鋼材用量也可望增加，為傳統建材業創造新的需求來源。不過，建築面積大幅成長，不代表整體水泥市場需求將以相同幅度增加，仍須考量資料中心建設占營建市場的比重。
CEMEX執行長Jaime Muguiro Domínguez在2026年第二季法說會指出，根據公司內部估算，2026年至2030年間，資料中心建設可能帶動美國每年水泥消費量增加約2%。
每年新增2%的需求增輛，可能仍不足以推升整體水泥廠的產能利用率，也難以扭轉原物料、能源及運輸成本帶來的獲利壓力。
不過，建材業者已開始取得實際訂單，尤其營運據點涵蓋資料中心建設熱區的供應商，正率先受惠於新增工程需求，並逐步反映在出貨量成長上。
CEMEX自2024年開始供應資料中心工程，2025年相關預拌混凝土出貨量成長185%，2026年至今又較去年同期增加一倍，目前參與資料中心工程投標的得標率達60%。儘管初期出貨基期較低，但連續兩年的快速成長，反映資料中心建設正在成為新的需求來源。
CEMEX主要透過預拌混凝土業務切入資料中心市場，並同步帶動上游水泥、砂石骨材及添加劑出貨。公司指出，美國資料中心建設最初集中在維吉尼亞州，如今已擴展至德州、加州、亞利桑那州及喬治亞州等地。若目前投資趨勢延續，美國資料中心年化建設支出約達500億美元，其中投資超過5億美元的超大型專案，約35%位於CEMEX既有業務涵蓋範圍。
其他建材業者也開始感受到需求增加。
Amrize在2026年第二季水泥出貨量成長5%、骨材出貨量增加6.5%，並指出資料中心與能源相關工程帶動大型專案需求增加6%。GCC則已開始供應Meta(META-US)位於德州El Paso、投資超過100億美元的資料中心工程，Eagle Materials也表示，客戶反映資料中心相關需求增加，但實際營收貢獻仍在評估中。
從工程端來看，資料中心投資也已陸續進入施工階段。營建商Skanska取得美國維吉尼亞州2.38億美元資料中心工程合約，並於2026年8月開工，預計2028年5月完工；另一項位於喬治亞州、規模48 MW的資料中心工程，合約金額8,400萬美元，預計2026年11月開工。這些案例顯示，AI資料中心建設不再只是企業宣布投資，而是已開始形成實際工程需求。
不過，AI資料中心對水泥產業的影響仍存在明顯區域差異。
美國因大型資料中心建設集中，且水泥與預拌混凝土受到運輸距離限制，工地附近的在地供應商較容易直接受惠。相較之下，中國雖然在2026年8月出現算力基礎設施專案得標金額年增近80%，但今年前7個月住宅新開工面積仍下滑24.2%，顯示新增資料中心工程短期內仍難以彌補房地產市場疲弱造成的水泥需求缺口。
韓國也面臨類似情況。當地水泥業持續受到住宅市場低迷與成本上升影響，市場開始期待AI資料中心及工業設施投資成為住宅以外的新需求來源，但目前仍缺乏相關工程已明顯帶動水泥廠出貨的具體數據。

paras_en: On October 8, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – The AI data‑center investment boom is extending its benefits from semiconductors and servers to traditional building‑material markets such as cement and concrete. While the market previously focused on how much capital tech giants were spending, attention is now shifting to the fact that these investments are turning into actual engineering orders. U.S. cement giants CEMEX, Amrize and GCC have successively confirmed in earnings calls that data‑center demand is driving shipments, showing that AI infrastructure construction has begun to generate revenue for the building‑materials sector.

Industry forecasts predict that global ultra‑large data‑center construction area will expand from 40.61 million square feet in 2024 to 72 million square feet by 2030 – an increase of 31.39 million square feet, or 77.3% over six years, with a compound annual growth rate of about 10.02%. As data‑center size grows, the need for cement, concrete and steel for foundations, slabs and related civil works is also expected to rise, creating a new demand source for traditional building‑materials firms. However, a surge in construction area does not mean overall cement market demand will grow at the same pace; the share of data‑center projects within the broader construction market must still be considered.

CEMEX CEO Jaime Muguiro Domínguez said at the company’s Q2 2026 earnings call that, based on internal estimates, data‑center construction could add roughly 2% to U.S. annual cement consumption between 2026 and 2030.

An additional 2% yearly demand increase may still be insufficient to lift overall cement‑plant capacity utilization and is unlikely to offset profit pressures from raw‑material, energy and transportation costs.

Nevertheless, building‑materials companies have begun securing actual orders, especially suppliers located in hot‑spot data‑center regions, who are first to benefit from the new engineering demand and are gradually reflecting it in shipment growth.

CEMEX has been supplying data‑center projects since 2024; ready‑mix concrete shipments grew 185% in 2025, and to date in 2026 they have doubled year‑over‑year. The win rate for bids on data‑center projects now stands at 60%. Although the base level was low initially, two consecutive years of rapid growth indicate that data‑center construction is becoming a new demand source.

CEMEX mainly enters the data‑center market through its ready‑mix concrete business, which also drives upstream shipments of cement, sand‑and‑gravel aggregates and admixtures. The company notes that U.S. data‑center construction, initially concentrated in Virginia, has now spread to Texas, California, Arizona and Georgia. If current investment trends continue, annual U.S. data‑center construction spending could reach about $50 billion, with roughly 35% of ultra‑large projects (those over $500 million) located within CEMEX’s existing service areas.
Other building‑materials firms are also feeling the demand lift.

Amrize reported a 5% rise in cement shipments and a 6.5% increase in aggregate shipments in Q2 2026, attributing a 6% boost in large‑project demand to data‑center and energy‑related engineering. GCC has begun supplying Meta’s (META‑US) Texas El Paso data‑center project, a venture exceeding $10 billion, while Eagle Materials said customers are indicating higher data‑center demand, though the revenue impact is still being assessed.

From the construction side, data‑center investments are moving into the building phase. Contractor Skanska secured a $238 million data‑center contract in Virginia, broke ground in August 2026 and expects completion in May 2028; another 48 MW data‑center project in Georgia, valued at $84 million, is slated to start construction in November 2026. These cases show that AI data‑center builds are no longer just announced investments but are generating real engineering demand.
However, the impact of AI data‑centers on the cement industry shows clear regional differences.

In the United States, the concentration of large data‑centers and the transport‑distance limits of cement and ready‑mix concrete mean local suppliers near sites can benefit directly. By contrast, China saw an almost 80% year‑over‑year increase in awarded compute‑infrastructure project value in August 2026, yet residential new‑construction area fell 24.2% in the first seven months of the year, indicating that new data‑center projects cannot quickly offset the cement‑demand gap caused by a weak real‑estate market.

South Korea faces a similar situation. Its cement sector remains pressured by a sluggish housing market and rising costs, and while the market hopes AI data‑centers and industrial‑facility investments will become new demand sources beyond housing, there is still a lack of concrete data showing that such projects have noticeably boosted cement‑plant shipments.

U.S. August trade deficit widened more than expected to a 17‑month high, likely dragging the economy again in Q3. Both San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly and Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid argue the Fed should raise policy rates further to curb rising inflation risk. A New York Fed report shows September supply‑chain pressure heating up, which could push inflation higher. Meanwhile, Banque de France Governor François Villeroy de Galhau said France’s economic situation is severe but does not yet require ECB intervention. Markets remain worried about France’s fiscal deterioration and a potentially polarising presidential election next year. Rising oil prices and climbing European sovereign‑bond yields have eroded confidence in the euro, pushing EUR/USD down to a 1.1164 low. Wednesday Lloyds Banking Group reported that UK September house prices were flat month‑on‑month and year‑on‑year, both missing expectations. paras: 美元周三(7日) 走強，升至近18個月高點，受到聯準會(Fed)會議紀要顯示可能進一步升息，以及歐元與英鎊走弱雙重支撐。歐元與英鎊受到全球債券拋售潮再度升溫拖累，承受下行壓力。

外匯市場參與者周三關注聯準會9月貨幣政策會議紀要。紀要顯示，多數聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)官員認為，今年年底前還可能再升息一次。
FOMC上個月一致投票決定將聯邦資金利率上調25個基點，為3年多來首次升息。同時，FOMC更新後的點陣圖也暗示今年還可能進一步升息。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)則在會後記者會上表示，讓通膨回落至央行2%的目標，仍是一項重大挑戰。
會議紀要指出，「關於本次會議之後的貨幣政策前景，多數與會者認為，在今年年底前進一步上調聯邦資金利率目標區間可能是適當的。」
紀要也顯示，所有FOMC官員都支持9月升息。
不過，這份紀要公布之際，市場對FOMC本月底再次升息的預期已較9月升息後大幅下降，主要受到近期部分官員偏鴿派的談話，以及美國經濟成長、通膨與勞動市場數據的影響。

法國今年財政赤字預計將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。

The euro and pound were pressured by a renewed wave of global bond sell‑offs, bearing downward pressure.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 102.24, briefly touching its highest level since April 9, 2025.

Forex market participants on Wednesday focused on the Fed’s September monetary policy meeting minutes. The minutes showed that most Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) members think another rate hike could still be possible before the end of the year.

Last month the FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate by 25 basis points, the first hike in more than three years. At the same time, the updated FOMC dot‑plot also hinted at the possibility of further hikes this year. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said in the post‑meeting press conference that bringing inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target remains a major challenge.

The minutes noted, “Regarding the monetary policy outlook after this meeting, most participants believe that a further increase in the target range for the federal funds rate may be appropriate before the end of this year.”
The minutes also showed that all FOMC members supported a September rate hike.

However, as the minutes were released, market expectations for another FOMC hike at the end of the month had fallen sharply from after the September hike, mainly due to recent dovish remarks by some officials and the impact of U.S. economic growth, inflation and labor market data.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 83% probability that rates will remain unchanged at the end of the month, up from about 54% a month ago.
Euro weighed down by France’s fiscal crisis
Another boost to the dollar’s strength was the euro’s decline on Wednesday. The euro fell 0.6% against the dollar to $1.1195 per euro.

As France’s fiscal crisis deepens and Spain’s politics stall, market risk sentiment across the continent is under pressure. France’s 10‑year government bond yield has risen to its highest level since early 2000.
France’s fiscal deficit this year is projected to reach 5.4% of GDP, with public debt close to 120% of GDP.
The French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion in spending and keep the fiscal deficit target at 5% of GDP.

At the same time, France faces political uncertainty ahead of two rounds of elections in April and May next year. National Rally leader Jordan Bardella, the party’s frontrunner in the presidential race, announced on Tuesday a major budget plan targeting €140 billion in savings by 2032.
Pound weakens as UK 30‑year gilt yield hits a 1998 high
A global bond sell‑off on Wednesday spread to the UK, pushing the 30‑year gilt yield to its highest level since January 1998.
Just a day earlier, UK Treasury Secretary John Healey met with the main dealers in the gilt market, the so‑called Gilt‑edged Market Makers (GEMMs).
The Treasury said the meeting discussed the severe external environment facing the UK and global economies, including geopolitical developments and financial market conditions.
The pound fell 0.5% against the dollar to $1.3213 per pound.

paras: 美元周二(6日)走弱，從近18個月高點回落。隨著歐元反彈，加上美國公債遭拋售的壓力有所緩解，美元漲勢暫歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報101.86點。目前仍徘徊2025年4月9日以來最高水準附近。
歐元受到歐洲公債殖利率趨於穩定帶動。法國總統大選主要候選人之一、極右派「國民聯盟」領袖雷朋(Marine Le Pen)承諾，如果當選將大幅削減政府支出。此外，歐洲央行(ECB)一名官員也發表較為正面的談話，進一步支撐歐元。
歐元兌美元上漲0.3%，至1.1259美元，擺脫近期一連串跌勢。此前法國債券市場動盪，導致歐元承受壓力。
法國10年期公債殖利率近期已升至2000年代初期以來未見水準，原因是該國面臨嚴重的財政與債務危機。法國10年期公債與德國聯邦公債之間的利差，也擴大至2012年歐元區債務危機以來的最大。
法國今年財政赤字預估將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務占GDP比重則逼近120%。法國現任政府上周公布2027年預算案，計劃透過削減540億歐元(約607.9億美元)政府支出，將財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。
不過，法國也正面臨政治不確定性，明年4月與5月將舉行兩輪總統大選。
領先候選人、極右派領袖雷朋，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算政策主張。
歐元同時受到歐洲央行首席經濟學家Philip Lane的談話提振。Lane表示，目前歐洲地區能源價格居高不下，但尚未引發歐元區經濟出現強烈的第二輪通膨效應。Lane周二接受義大利通訊社《ANSA》訪問時強調，能源價格上漲究竟會在多大程度上傳導至整體物價，目前仍存在高度不確定性。
美元暫歇 公債買盤回溫
隨著美國公債殖利率下滑，美元漲勢也暫時停歇。
10年期美國公債殖利率下跌3.5個基點，收在5.278%，30年期公債殖利率則小幅下滑，收在5.661%。兩者近期都曾升至2002年初以來的最高水準。
市場對油價推升通膨衝擊的擔憂、企業為建設AI基礎設施而大量發債的疑慮、各國央行偏向鷹派的貨幣政策，以及不斷膨脹的政府債務，都加劇了近期美國公債遭拋售的壓力。
法國的政治與財政動盪，也進一步加深市場不安。
儘管市場對聯準會(Fed)即將收緊貨幣政策的預期已經降低，美元仍維持在相對高檔。
近期公布的通膨與就業市場數據顯示，聯準會可能獲得一些喘息空間，暫時維持利率不變。
美國總統川普周二被問及美元兌歐元走強一事時表示，這是因為美國「表現良好」，並稱強勢美元「不會帶來通膨」。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Tuesday (the 6th), retreating from an 18‑month high. With the euro rebounding and pressure on US Treasury sales easing, the dollar's rally paused.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 101.86 points, still hovering near its highest level since April 9, 2025.

The euro was buoyed by stabilising European sovereign yields. One of the main candidates in the French presidential race, far‑right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen, pledged to slash government spending dramatically if elected. In addition, an ECB official made relatively positive remarks, further supporting the euro.
The euro rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1259, breaking a recent string of declines. Previously, turbulence in the French bond market had put pressure on the euro.

France's 10‑year government bond yield has recently climbed to levels not seen since the early 2000s, driven by a severe fiscal and debt crisis. The spread between French 10‑year yields and German Bunds has also widened to its widest since the 2012 euro‑zone debt crisis.

France's fiscal deficit this year is projected at 5.4% of GDP, with public debt approaching 120% of GDP. The incumbent French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, planning to cut €54 billion (about $60.79 billion) in spending to keep the deficit at 5% of GDP.
However, France also faces political uncertainty, with two rounds of the presidential election scheduled for April and May next year.
Leading candidate and far‑right leader Le Pen, together with party chief Jordan Bardella, announced their main budget policy proposals on Tuesday.

The euro also received a lift from comments by ECB chief economist Philip Lane. Lane said that while energy prices in the euro area remain high, they have not yet triggered a strong second‑round inflation effect. In an interview with Italy's ANSA on Tuesday, Lane stressed that the extent to which higher energy costs will feed through to overall prices remains highly uncertain.
Dollar rally pauses as Treasury buying returns.
With US Treasury yields falling, the dollar's advance has temporarily stalled.
The 10‑year US Treasury yield dropped 3.5 basis points to 5.278%, while the 30‑year yield slipped slightly to 5.661%. Both had recently risen to their highest levels since early 2002.

Market worries about oil‑driven inflation, corporations issuing large amounts of debt to build AI infrastructure, hawkish monetary policies from central banks, and ever‑growing sovereign debt have all intensified recent pressure on US Treasuries.
France's political and fiscal turmoil has further deepened market unease.
Even though expectations that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy have eased, the dollar remains at relatively elevated levels.
Recent inflation and employment data suggest the Fed may have some breathing room to keep rates unchanged for now.
When asked about the dollar’s strength against the euro, US President Donald Trump said it was because the United States "is performing well" and claimed a strong dollar "won’t cause inflation".

items.title: 關稅擋不住進口！美國8月貿易逆差衝上1056億美元 創逾一年最大
items.title_en: Tariffs Can't Stop Imports! U.S. August Trade Deficit Swells to $105.6 Billion, Largest in Over a Year
paras: 美國8月貿易逆差擴大至1,056億美元，創2025年初以來最大，且超出市場預期。AI建設帶動半導體與設備進口，加上能源成本上升及關稅政策干擾，推升進口額至歷史新高，貿易恐再度拖累第三季經濟成長。不過，強勁內需也顯示消費與企業投資仍具支撐力。
美國商務部周二(6日)公布，8月商品與服務貿易逆差較前月擴大13.7%，高於市場預估的約1,020億美元，7月逆差則修正為928億美元。8月進口月增4.3%至4,208億美元，出口僅增1.4%至3,152億美元，成長速度明顯落後。

AI建設拉動進口 半導體增額創紀錄

8月商品進口月增5.3%至3,422億美元，商品出口增加2.2%至2,057億美元。經通膨調整後，商品貿易逆差擴大至1,147億美元，為2025年3月以來最大。
包含電腦及周邊、半導體與電信設備的資本財進口，較前月增加62億美元。其中，半導體進口增加24億美元，創單月增額紀錄，民用飛機與電信設備進口也上升，反映AI投資熱潮持續仰賴海外供應。
包含石油及石油產品的工業原料進口增加91億美元，出口增加63億美元，其中原油出口增加20億美元。非貨幣性黃金進出口也同步增加。相較之下，服務出口大致持平，受訪美旅客支出降至2023年8月以來最低拖累。
美國第二季內需增速創逾三年半最快，消費與AI相關設備投資強勁。8月消費支出及核心資本財訂單、出貨數據顯示，這股動能延續至第三季，企業則持續依靠進口滿足需求。

貿易恐續拖累GDP 關稅未阻進口攀升

貿易已連續三季拖累美國國內生產毛額(GDP)，經濟學家估計，第三季拖累幅度可能達2.5個百分點。最新數據公布前，亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型估計，淨出口將拉低第三季GDP成長率2.59個百分點，將是2025年初以來最大拖累。
不過，市場對第三季經濟成長率的預估多高於年率3%，預期消費支出可抵銷進口帶來的拖累，優於第二季的2.2%。
川普主張加徵關稅有助縮小逆差，但進口仍持續攀升。關稅變動、戰爭引發的油價波動及供應鏈挑戰，也使未經通膨調整的每月貿易數據劇烈起伏。
分國別來看，美國對加拿大商品逆差擴大至2025年初以來最高。8月貿易談判破局後，兩國企業搶在關稅生效前加速出貨；美國8月22日起對數十億美元加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大隨後反制。美國對墨西哥、越南的商品逆差均小幅擴大至新高，對半導體重要供應地台灣的逆差也增加。
paras_en: U.S. August trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion, the biggest since early 2025 and above market expectations. AI build‑out drove semiconductor and equipment imports, while higher energy costs and tariff policy disruptions pushed total imports to a historic high, threatening to again drag down third‑quarter economic growth. Nevertheless, strong domestic demand shows consumption and corporate investment remain supportive.

The U.S. Department of Commerce reported on Tuesday (the 6th) that the goods‑and‑services trade deficit for August expanded 13.7% from the prior month, exceeding the market forecast of roughly $102 billion; the July deficit was revised to $92.8 billion. August imports rose 4.3% month‑over‑month to $420.8 billion, while exports increased only 1.4% to $315.2 billion, a clearly slower growth rate.

AI construction pulled imports higher, with semiconductor imports hitting a record increase. August goods imports rose 5.3% month‑over‑month to $342.2 billion, while goods exports grew 2.2% to $205.7 billion. After inflation adjustment, the goods trade deficit expanded to $114.7 billion, the largest since March 2025.

Imports of capital goods—including computers and peripherals, semiconductors and telecom equipment—rose by $6.2 billion from the prior month. Semiconductor imports alone jumped $2.4 billion, setting a new single‑month increase record, while civil aircraft and telecom equipment imports also rose, reflecting the continued reliance on overseas supply for the AI investment boom.

Imports of industrial raw materials, including oil and petroleum products, increased by $9.1 billion, while exports rose $6.3 billion, with crude oil exports up $2.0 billion. Non‑monetary gold imports and exports also grew. By contrast, services exports were roughly flat, weighed down by U.S. visitor spending falling to its lowest level since August 2023.

U.S. domestic demand in the second quarter grew at the fastest pace in more than three and a half years, with strong consumer spending and AI‑related equipment investment. August consumer outlays and core capital‑goods orders and shipments indicate this momentum will carry into the third quarter, as firms continue to rely on imports to meet demand.

Trade has been a drag on U.S. gross domestic product (GDP) for three consecutive quarters, and economists estimate the third‑quarter drag could reach 2.5 percentage points. Ahead of the latest data release, the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model projected that net exports would shave 2.59 percentage points off third‑quarter GDP growth, the biggest drag since early 2025.

However, market forecasts for third‑quarter GDP growth are generally above an annualized 3%, with expectations that consumer spending will offset the import‑related drag, improving on the second quarter’s 2.2% rate.

Former President Trump argues that higher tariffs help narrow the deficit, yet imports keep climbing. Tariff changes, war‑driven oil‑price volatility and supply‑chain challenges also cause unadjusted monthly trade figures to swing sharply.

By country, the U.S. deficit with Canada rose to its highest level since early 2025. After trade talks broke down in August, firms in both nations rushed to ship goods before tariffs took effect; the U.S. imposed a 50% tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian goods starting August 22, prompting a Canadian retaliation. Deficits with Mexico and Vietnam also edged higher to new highs, and the deficit with Taiwan, a key semiconductor supplier, increased as well.

paras: 台股加權指數上看5萬點近關情怯，台北匯市也陷入震盪，新台幣由升轉貶，但收盤前15分鐘又轉升，買賣匯力道陷入拉鋸戰，新台幣兌一美元終場收在31.781元，升值0.7分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值縮至16.04億美元。

統一投顧則提到，儘管國際油價和美債殖利率居高不下，但輝達市值創高，市場將焦點轉向科技財報，台股目前技術面強勢，台指期夜盤再衝5萬大關展現多方控盤底氣，本周上市櫃公司陸續公布9月營收，AI 供應鏈族群預期可望持續繳出佳績，同時，世界AI高峰會和大立光(3008-TW)、台積電(2330-TW)等法說會即將登場，台股題材充沛。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange weighted index hovered near the 50,000‑point psychological barrier, and the Taipei foreign‑exchange market also entered a range‑bound session. The New Taiwan dollar (NTD) switched from appreciation to depreciation, but turned back up in the last 15 minutes of trading, leaving the buying‑selling pressure in a tug‑of‑war. The NTD finished at 31.781 per US dollar, up 0.7 cents, while the turnover of Taipei FX brokerage firms fell to $1.604 billion.
The NTD opened today at 31.76, up 2.8 cents, rose to a high of 31.699, then after the midday session slipped, reaching a low of 31.823. The intraday high‑low spread was 0.124 NTD.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won gained about 0.3%, the Thai baht rose roughly 0.1%, the Singapore dollar edged up about 0.05%, the NTD closed up 0.02%, the Japanese yen weakened by nearly 0.2%, and the US dollar index fell about 0.2%.

Yuanta Securities Research noted that persistently high US Treasury yields, volatile US‑Iran geopolitical tensions, and the upcoming US mid‑term elections could heighten global equity market volatility, and advised investors to watch out for the risk of chasing strong‑stock price rallies.

Unified Securities Research said that despite high international oil prices and US Treasury yields, Nvidia’s market cap hit new highs, shifting market focus to tech earnings. Taiwan’s market remains technically strong, with the Taiwan index futures pushing toward the 50,000 mark in the night session, showing bullish confidence. This week, listed companies will release September revenues, and the AI supply‑chain sector is expected to continue delivering solid results. Meanwhile, the World AI Summit and earnings calls for Largan Precision (3008‑TW) and TSMC (2330‑TW) are imminent, providing abundant themes for the Taiwan market.
